children: How Do Market Agencements Evolve?
市场装配如何演化？
In the social sciences, few philosophical concepts have met with as much success as the notion of
dispositif

. This surprising adventure begins with Michel Foucault’s work. Although the notion is present throughout his writings, the most precise and detailed definition appears in an oft-quoted 1977 interview:
在社会科学中，很少有哲学概念像装置（
dispositif
）这一概念那样取得如此巨大的成功。这段令人惊异的历程始于米歇尔·福柯（Michel Foucault）的著作。尽管这一概念贯穿于他的全部写作，但最精确、最详细的定义出现在1977年的一次访谈中，这次访谈常被引用：

What I’m trying to pick out with this term is, firstly, a thoroughly heteroge- neous ensemble consisting of discourses, institutions, architectural forms, regulatory decisions, laws, administrative measures, scientific statements, philosophical, moral and philanthropic propositions — in short, the said as much as the unsaid. Such are the elements of the apparatus [
dispositif

]. The apparatus itself is the system of relations that can be established between these elements. . . . I understand by the term ‘apparatus’ a sort of shall we say — formation which has as its major function at a given historical moment that of responding to an
urgent need
. The apparatus thus has a dominant strategic function. . . . I said that the apparatus is essentially of a
strategic

nature, which means assuming that it is a matter of a certain manipula- tion of relations of forces, either developing them in a particular direction, blocking them, stabilizing them, utilizing them, etc. The apparatus is thus always inscribed in a play of power, but it is also always linked to certain limits of knowledge that arise from it but, to an equal degree, condition it. This is what the apparatus consists in: strategies of relations of forces sup- porting, and supported by, types of knowledge.
我想用这个词标出的，首先是一个彻底异质的集合，它由话语、制度、建筑形式、规制性决定、法律、行政措施、科学陈述，以及哲学的、道德的与慈善性的主张组成——简言之，既包括被说出的，也包括未被说出的。这些就是装置［
dispositif
］的要素。装置本身，则是能够在这些要素之间建立起来的关系系统。……我所谓的“装置”，是这样一种——我们不妨说——构形：在某一既定历史时刻，它的主要功能是回应一种
紧迫的需要
。因此，装置具有一种支配性的战略功能。……我曾说过，装置本质上是
战略性
的，这意味着它涉及对力量关系的某种操纵：或者把力量关系引向某个特定方向，或者阻断它们、稳定它们、利用它们，等等。因此，装置总是铭刻在权力的游戏之中，但它也始终与某些知识的界限相关联——这些界限由装置产生，但同样程度地制约着装置。装置之所是，正在于此：支持着各类知识、同时也被各类知识所支持的力量关系之策略。
As Giorgio Agamben suggests, this definition can be summarized in three points:
a) it involves a heterogeneous set of elements, the
dispositif
in itself being the network that connects these elements;
b) given its strategic dimension, the
dispositif
is inscribed in power relations;
c) as such, it is the result of the intersection between power and knowledge relations.
Thus defined, the
dispositif

has a general character that allows for approaching prisons, the police, religion, and yes, markets in the same terms. It contributes to the study of the mechanisms through which living beings (notably, human beings) are caught up in webs of constraints that are often born of successive historical sedimentations and that make emerge and format new forms of subjectivity (such as that of
homo economicus

) and new modalities of action associated with these subjectivities (such as the pursuit of profit or maximal satisfaction), all of which do not have universal value, but appear at a given moment as a historical singularity. As Foucault will later underline, these constraints apply not only to the governed, but also to those who govern. Although Agamben is fairly silent on this point, it should be added that discourses play a significant role in constituting
dispositifs
and rendering them explicit. Discourses determine the borders of
dispositifs
and enunciate their truth while at the same time being one of their constitutive elements. They are neither inside nor outside, neither infrastructure nor superstructure. No
dispositifs
without discourse; no discourse without
dispositifs
. Discourses give access to
dispositifs
, but as Paul Veyne rightly emphasizes, “one cannot separate the modality of accession from that to which it offers access.”
正如吉奥乔·阿甘本（Giorgio Agamben）所提示的，这一定义可以概括为三点：
a）它涉及一组异质的要素，
装置
本身则是连接这些要素的网络；
b）鉴于其战略维度，
装置
铭刻于权力关系之中；
c）因此，它是权力关系与知识关系相交的结果。
如此界定之后，
装置
便具有一种普遍性，使人们能够以同样的方式探讨监狱、警察、宗教，当然还有市场。它有助于研究这样一些机制：活生生的存在者（尤其是人）通过这些机制被卷入约束之网，这些约束往往产生于历次历史沉积，并促成新的主体性形式（例如经济人［
homo economicus
］的主体性形式）以及与之相关联的新行动方式（例如追求利润或最大满足）的出现与格式化；所有这些都不具有普遍价值，而是在某一时刻作为历史的独一性浮现出来。正如福柯后来所强调的，这些约束不仅施于被治理者，也施于治理者。尽管阿甘本在这一点上着墨不多，但还应补充：话语在构成
装置
并使之明晰化的过程中起着重要作用。话语规定
装置
的边界，陈述其真理，同时自身又是
装置
的构成要素之一。它们既不在内部，也不在外部；既不是基础，也不是上层建筑。没有话语就没有
装置
；没有
装置
也没有话语。话语使人得以通达
装置
，但正如保罗·韦纳（Paul Veyne）所正确强调的，“人们无法把通达的方式与它所提供通达的对象分离开来”。
As can be seen in Foucault’s definition, one of the reasons to turn to the notion of
dispositif

is that it frees thought from a view of the social that establishes strict distinctions between spheres, fields, subsystems, separate and distinct institutions. It is, of course, out of the question to contest that differences exist. There are recognizable dissimilarities between a legal ruling, a scientific theory, a moral principle, a convention, an industrial machine, and an enzyme, and when one walks into a church (whether or not there are moneychangers in the temple), one knows it is not a supermarket. It is, rather, a matter of maintaining that one can never move directly from one principle to another, one proposition to another, one generation of machines to another, or one commodity to another without a detour that involves and mobilizes a set of elements external to the relevant sphere of activity. That is the meaning of the term “heterogeneity.” No doubt Foucault would add that these detours are not fortuitous, but are instead determined by models, by regularities, that constitute the
dispositifs

and networks he describes. There is, for instance, a certain way of using instruments to develop a theory, to test a machine to make it more efficient, or to manage a company to ensure its sustainability, and so on. In other words, the notion of
dispositif

makes it possible to capture reproduction and innovation in a single movement without having recourse to such notions as structures, institutions, or fields; those notions do impose regularities, but they make it difficult to explain how regularities sometimes give way to novelty. The notion of
dispositif
makes singularities comprehensible: every observable event, such as the elaboration of a new scientific proposition or the institution of a new bilateral transaction, is a
concatenatio causarum
, an intertwining of creative uprisings and repetitive behaviors, of movements of revolt or resistance and acts of obedience. The
dispositif
is like a machine that is designed to manufacture homogeneous objects from heterogeneous ingredients.
从福柯的定义中可以看到，转向
装置

概念的理由之一在于：它使思想摆脱这样一种社会观——这种社会观在各领域、各场域、各子系统以及彼此分离而独立的制度之间划定严格的区分。当然，要否认差异的存在是不可能的。一项司法裁决、一种科学理论、一条道德原则、一项惯例、一台工业机器与一种酶之间，存在着可辨识的差异；而当人走进一座教堂时（无论圣殿里有没有兑换银钱的人），他知道那不是一家超市。这里要主张的毋宁是：人们永远无法从一个原则直接过渡到另一个原则，从一个命题到另一个命题，从一代机器到另一代机器，或从一种商品到另一种商品，而不经过一次迂回——这次迂回牵涉并调动该相关活动领域之外的一整套要素。这正是“异质性”一词的含义。福柯无疑会补充说，这些迂回并非偶然，而是由模式、由规则性所决定，而这些模式与规则性构成了他所描述的
装置
与网络。例如，存在着某种特定的方式，去运用仪器发展一种理论、测试一台机器使其更有效率，或经营一家公司以确保其可持续性，等等。换言之，
装置
这一概念使人能够在同一个运动中把握再生产与创新，而无须求助于结构、制度或场域之类的概念；这些概念确实强加了规则性，但它们使人难以解释规则性有时如何让位于新事物。
装置
这一概念使独一性变得可以理解：每一个可观察的事件——例如提出一项新的科学命题，或设立一笔新的双边交易——都是原因的串联（
concatenatio causarum
），是创造性的起义与重复性的行为、反抗或抵抗的运动与服从的行为相互交织。
装置
就像一台机器，其设计目的就是从异质的原料中制造出同质的物品。
The advantage of the notion of
dispositif

, as Foucault defines it, is that it prioritizes detailed analyses of observable material and discursive practices that we now know must be described, whether in science, law, economics, or other fields, as the putting into relation of separate dissimilar elements in order to face the problems that arise, one by one. A
dispositif

is sufficiently flexible and variable (reconfigurable) to explain creation, innovation, and change mechanisms and sufficiently rigid to identify what, in these dynamics, involves repetition and reproduction.
福柯所定义的
装置
概念，其优势在于：它优先重视对可观察的物质实践与话语实践的细致分析；我们现在知道，无论在科学、法律、经济还是其他领域，这些实践都必须被描述为把彼此分离而不相似的要素相互关联起来，以逐一应对出现的问题。
装置
足够灵活、足够可变（可重新配置），因而能够解释创造、创新与变迁的机制；它也足够刚性，因而能够辨识这些动态中哪些涉及重复与再生产。
WHY THE TERM MARKET “AGENCEMENTS” AND NOT “DISPOSITIFS”?
为何用“市场装配”而非“装置”？
Given all this, why would I choose the term “market agencements,” rather than “market
dispositifs
”? The main reason is because the way the notion of
dispositif
has been understood and used has linked it with hypotheses and positions that are rarely made explicit or debated, but that have deeply altered its meaning.
既然如此，我为何选择“市场装配”一词，而不用“市场
装置
”呢？主要原因在于：
装置
概念被理解和运用的方式，已把它与一些假设和立场联系在一起；这些假设和立场很少被明确表述或公开讨论，却深刻地改变了它的含义。
The first difficulty is linked to the distinction that is implicitly accepted, although rarely acknowledged, between living beings and the
dispositifs

(as defined above) in which these living beings are caught and formatted. There are signs of this propensity to repeat the great divide. One of them is the emphasis Foucault puts on the strategic part the social sciences play in the
dispositifs
he studied. At the heart of the Foucauldian
dispositif

is a requirement that justifies its raison d’être, which is, in the words of Agamben, to “manage, govern, control, and orient — in a way that purports to be useful —the behaviors, gestures and opinions of living beings.”
The
dispositif
’s main function is to dispose of man. Seen from this perspective, it shapes man’s dispositions, which implies that the human and nonhuman components can be separated within the
dispositif

without challenging its internal economy. The dissymmetry introduced between different types of scientific knowledge is striking: nonhuman technosciences are limited to being resources that can be mobilized without interfering with human subjectivities whereas humanities play a unique role in shaping and enacting the latter. To put it crudely: studying quarks does not bring anything substantial to the project of constituting human dispositions whereas the very purpose of psychology, psychoanalysis, sociology, or economics is to contribute to this subjectification. Life sciences, however, occupy an intermediary position. Granted, they work to identify and objectify new entities (genes, antibodies, viruses) that extend the scope of available resources, but at the same time, they profoundly renew what we know about human identities as well as the tools to intervene with, and to reshape, them. That is why many extremely interesting and original studies have used a Foucauldian perspective to analyze findings from genetics, biotechnologies,
or pharmaceutical psychiatry.
One can go further in proposing a more refined analysis of the part molecules play in the construction of identity, further reducing the gap between
dispositif
and disposition.
By making the association between humans and nonhumans (whether animated or inanimate entities) into the hallmark of
dispositifs
, the sociology of translation (or actor-network theory) made it possible to get away from this distinction altogether. In order to underline the change, in this new perspective,
dispositifs
are renamed “assemblages” or “arrangements,” or, indeed “agencements.”
第一个困难涉及一种区分：它在活生生的存在者与这些存在者被卷入并被格式化的
装置
（如上文所定义）之间作出区分，这种区分被默认接受，却很少被承认。这种重演大分裂的倾向有种种迹象。其中之一是福柯对他所研究的
装置
中社会科学所扮演的战略性角色所作的强调。福柯式
装置
的核心，是一项使其存在理由（raison d’être）得以成立的要求；用阿甘本的话说，这就是“管理、治理、控制和引导——以一种自称有用的方式——活生生的存在者的行为、姿态与意见”。
装置
的主要功能就是处置人。从这个角度看，
装置
塑造人的禀性（dispositions），这意味着在
装置

内部可以把人的成分与非人的成分分离开来，而不动摇其内部组织与运作。不同类型科学知识之间被引入的不对称十分醒目：以非人为对象的技术科学被限定为可供调动的资源，而不会干扰人的主体性；人文学科则在塑造并施行这种主体性方面扮演独特角色。说得粗率些：研究夸克对人的禀性之构成计划并无实质贡献，而心理学、精神分析、社会学或经济学的宗旨本身，就是促成这种主体化。然而，生命科学占据一个中间位置。诚然，它们致力于识别并把新的实体（基因、抗体、病毒）客体化，从而扩展可用资源的范围；但与此同时，它们也深刻更新了我们对人的身份的认识，以及干预并重塑这些身份的工具。正因如此，许多极有趣味且富有原创性的研究，运用福柯式视角分析遗传学、生物技术
或药物精神病学
的发现。人们还可以更进一步，对分子在身份建构中所起的作用提出更精细的分析，从而进一步缩小
装置
与禀性之间的裂隙。
通过把人—非人（无论是有生命的还是无生命的实体）之间的联合确立为
装置
的标志，转译社会学（或称行动者网络理论）使人们得以彻底摆脱这一区分。为强调这一变化，在这一新视角中，
装置
被重新命名为“集合体”（assemblages）、“安排”（arrangements），或者干脆称为“装配”（agencements）。
The second reason to choose the term “agencement” follows in part from the first. Although it comes from an interpretation of the notion of
dispositif
that I have criticized for being reductionist, it is potentially included in and even strongly suggested by that definition. Indeed, asserting the bipolar nature of a
dispositif

(the network of heterogeneous elements that enter into the disposition of human beings, which the latter have at their disposal) opens the way to making the assemblage of heterogeneous elements that constitutes the
dispositif
into a variable result of purely combinatory practices. It is as if the relation between the human and nonhuman elements of the
dispositif
were not reciprocally constitutive relations: the
dispositif
and its network of constraints then give way to an assemblage, like a game of LEGO.
选择“装配”一词的第二个理由，部分地由第一个理由引出。尽管它源自一种我曾批评为还原论的
装置
概念解释，但这种解释潜在地包含于、甚至强烈地暗示于那一定义之中。事实上，断言
装置
具有双极性（异质要素的网络进入人的配置之中，而后者可支配这一网络），就为如下做法开辟了道路：把构成
装置
的异质要素之集合，变成纯粹组合性实践的可变结果。这就仿佛
装置
中人与非人要素之间的关系并不是相互构成的关系：
装置
及其约束之网于是让位于一个集合体，就像一场乐高游戏。
This drift has been all the more marked with the translation of the term
dispositif

into English, which has raised innumerable problems. “Device” and “apparatus,” the two favored terms, have the disadvantage of evoking the material and mechanical world of technical artifacts. They accentuate the distinction between the human and the nonhuman, two poles that Foucault is intent on joining, even though he tends to separate them. And if that were not enough, this questionable translation has been reinforced by the translation of “agencement,” a notion deliberately introduced by Deleuze and Guattari to refine and enrich Foucault’s analysis.
Whereas “agencement” evokes an arrangement’s capacity to act, the translators opted for the notion of assemblage, which accentuates, rather than erases the limits of the notion of
dispositif
. (They might have imagined a neologism,
agencing

for instance, which has the advantage of suggesting that an agencement is an agency considered both in its capacity to act and its constitution.) Foucault, who has had a greater influence on the Anglo-Saxon social sciences than on studies within France, has certainly suffered from these treacherous translations, but the social sciences have also suffered from them. Agencement has boomeranged back to the French social sciences in the guise of “assemblage” (whose only virtue is that it is both an English and a French word) or even as “arrangement.” These two notions risk erasing what is innovative in
dispositif
and especially in agencement, as Deleuze defines it, revisiting Foucault.
随着
dispositif

一词被译成英文，这种偏移变得更为显著，并引发了无数问题。“device”与“apparatus”这两个受青睐的译法有一个缺点：它们让人联想到技术人工物的物质与机械世界。它们强化了人与非人之间的区分，而福柯恰恰想要把这两个极联结起来，尽管他本人也倾向于把它们分开。更有甚者，这一可疑的翻译又因“装配”（agencement）一词的翻译而得到加强——这一概念是德勒兹与加塔利有意引入的，用以提炼并丰富福柯的分析。
“agencement”唤起的是安排所具有的行动能力，而译者却选择了“assemblage”（集合体）这一概念，它强化而非消解了
dispositif
概念的界限。（他们本可以构想一个新词，例如“
agencing

”（装配化），其优点在于暗示一个 agencement 就是一种能动者（agency），既应就其行动能力、也应就其构成来加以考虑。）福柯在盎格鲁-撒克逊社会科学中的影响大于其在法国本土研究中的影响，他无疑深受这些背信弃义的翻译之害，但社会科学也同样受害。agencement 以“assemblage”（其唯一优点在于它既是英语词又是法语词）乃至“arrangement”的面貌回旋到法国社会科学之中。这两个概念有可能抹去
dispositif
、尤其是德勒兹在重访福柯时所定义的 agencement 之中的创新之处。

The initial victims of this drift in meaning understood the problem. The difficulties Anglo-Saxon colleagues faced and the ways they tried to overcome them are interesting for my purposes. Take the example of Manuel De Landa’s book, which aims, among other things, to clarify Deleuze’s and Foucault’s contributions.

De Landa insists on the fact that the different elements that make up an assemblage (human or nonhuman) have their own lives and existences. In other words, according to him, the relations between the elements that make up an assemblage are in no way necessary (organic); they are historically contingent. From the perspective of the social sciences, this formulation, which insists on the particular ontology of assemblages, leads to the following propositions:
a) every
social
entity is made up of heterogeneous elements (materials, humans, texts, and so on);
b) each of these elements has its own dynamic, which unfolds in a space and according to a temporality to which it is attached;

c) the entity composed of these elements evolves and transforms depending on the interactions of its elements: the effects of these interactions do not follow from any simple causality and are largely contingent;
d) an element can be extracted from a given assemblage and introduced into another
dispositif
, where it will enter into new interactions, producing different effects;

e) distinguishing between entities that would be intrinsically macro or micro makes no sense since an element can be included in one assemblage, but once detached from that assemblage, it can be considered as an entity that, in turn, includes a whole series of elements and therefore constitutes a world of its own.
这种意义偏移的最初受害者理解这一问题。盎格鲁-撒克逊同行所面临的困难，以及他们试图克服这些困难的方式，对我的论题很有意义。以曼努埃尔·德兰达（Manuel De Landa）的书为例，该书的宗旨之一就是澄清德勒兹与福柯的贡献。
德兰达坚持这样一个事实：构成一个集合体（assemblage）的不同要素（人的或非人的）各有其生命与存在。换言之，在他看来，构成集合体的诸要素之间的关系绝不是必然的（有机的）；它们是历史地偶然的。从社会科学的视角看，这一强调集合体特殊本体论的表述引出以下命题：
a）每一个
社会
实体都由异质要素（物质、人、文本等等）构成；
b）这些要素中的每一个都有自身的动态，这种动态在它所附着的空间与时间性中展开；
c）由这些要素构成的实体，依其要素之间的互动而演化与转化：这些互动的效果并不遵循任何简单的因果性，而在很大程度上是偶然的；
d）一个要素可以从某一既定集合体中抽离出来，引入另一个
装置
，在那里进入新的互动，产生不同的效果；
e）在本质上是宏观或微观的实体之间作出区分毫无意义，因为一个要素可以被包含在一个集合体中，而一旦脱离该集合体，它就可以被视为一个实体，这个实体反过来又包含一整套要素，因而构成一个自己的世界。

To illustrate this, let us take the example of a city. A city can be described as bringing together populations, industrial activities, a network of roads, organizations, public policies, political movements, regulations, unemployed youth, advertising slogans, and so on. The populations are inscribed in cycles of existence that play out over several years, whereas the time frame for some companies may be limited to a few months. It is hard to anticipate how the city will evolve, given how complex and unpredictable the interactions are between populations, economic activities, evolution of the electoral system, and so on. It is clear that there is value in describing the city as an assemblage, if only because it allows for greater realism in the analysis. However, at the same time, one can understand the skepticism this approach can provoke. By insisting too much on the constitutive complexity of assemblages, one risks abandoning too easily any hope of reaching realistic simplifications that require that one make a choice, determining the most significant variables, rather than simply celebrating the world’s complexity. Yet how far should one go, for instance, in decomposing the assemblage into its constitutive elements, given that each of them is itself an assemblage,
all the way down

? The description of the city becomes as monstrous as the city itself. It might even be that the description contributes to rendering it even more monstrous than it is. What is true for cities is true for markets and the assemblages from which they are constituted.

为说明这一点，让我们以城市为例。城市可以被描述为人口、工业活动、道路网络、组织、公共政策、政治运动、规制、失业青年、广告标语等等的聚集。人口被铭刻在历时数年的存在周期之中，而某些公司的时间框架可能仅限于几个月。鉴于人口、经济活动、选举制度的演变等等之间的互动如此复杂而不可预测，很难预料城市将如何演化。显然，把城市描述为一个集合体是有价值的，哪怕只是因为它使分析更为贴近现实。然而，与此同时，人们也能理解这种进路可能引发的怀疑。过分坚持集合体的构成性复杂，人们就可能过于轻易地放弃任何作出符合实际的简化的希望——这种简化要求作出选择、确定最有意义的变量，而不是仅仅颂扬世界的复杂性。可是，举例来说，在把集合体分解为其构成要素时，应当走到多远，既然每一个要素本身又是一个集合体，如此
层层下推
？对城市的描述于是变得像城市本身一样庞杂怪诞。甚至可能的是，这种描述反倒使城市显得比它本身更加庞杂怪诞。对城市成立的东西，对市场以及构成市场的集合体也同样成立。
AN AGENCEMENT ACTS
装配会行动

To escape this impasse requires coming back to one of the questions Foucault and Deleuze raised about the sources and modalities of action. The notion of agencement brings an answer to this question more explicitly than the notions of
dispositif

, assemblage, or arrangement ever could. An agencement cannot be reduced to a complicated configuration of elements associated with each other in a particular way; it is also and especially what acts. In his own definition of the notion of agencement, as well as in his commentary on Foucault’s work, notably on
Discipline and Punish

, Deleuze emphasizes that agencement allows one to move beyond the opposition between expression and content, between material forms and formalized functions as introduced by structuralism and “vulgar” Marxism.

For instance, material forms such as the prison or the hospital, whose resemblances have often been noted, fulfill different functions: in one case, to punish, in the other, to heal, which are, of course, not exactly the same thing. Deleuze takes up the diagram Foucault proposed in order to refer to the entanglement of what has generally been called the assemblage (or the arrangement, or even the
dispositif

) and the modes of action that it deploys and structures. The diagram profiles a certain mode of action for the agencement. The panopticon and its diagram are useful in each situation in which a task or conduct has to be imposed on multiple individuals. Starting from this observation and in order to clarify a terminology fraught with a number of ambiguities, I suggest we restrict the notion of agencement to the combination arrangement plus specific action and that we qualify agencement in such a way as to designate the type of specific action in play. Thus, we can speak of technical, political, or scientific agencements, each one giving shape, through the framings it organizes, to a certain mode of collective action — that is, a coordinated action around a strategic goal such as a bilateral transaction, in the case of market agencements.

例如，监狱或医院这样的物质形式，其相似性常被指出，但它们履行不同的功能：一种是为了惩罚，另一种是为了治疗——这两者当然并不完全是一回事。德勒兹采纳了福柯提出的“图示”，用以指称通常被称为集合体（或安排，乃至
装置

A market agencement is any agencement that in practice solves the problem of attaching a good to an agency in exchange for monetary payment. In other words, its function is to institute bilateral commercial transactions. This specificity of the collective action (or function) is obtained through a series of interdependent framings that I have described in the previous chapters. These framings produce strong constraints, weaving power relations that orient the action and make it a market action by structuring the elementary operations of which it is composed.
市场装配就是任何在实践中解决了如下问题的装配：以货币支付为交换，把一件物品附着于一个能动者。换言之，其功能是设立双边商业交易。集体行动（或功能）的这种特殊性，是通过我在前几章中描述过的一系列相互依存的框定而获得的。这些框定产生强有力的约束，编织出种种权力关系；这些权力关系为行动定向，并通过结构其构成性的基本操作，使该行动成为市场行动。

The analysis this book offers is compatible with the general definition of an assemblage. Here one finds the heterogeneous elements, the entanglement of discourses and material entities, the possibility for each of these elements to follow its own trajectory, to enter into other assemblages, and to be analyzed, in turn, as an assemblage. Teeming interactions and the absence of simple, univocal determinations are also to be found here. Pricing, for instance, is the result of formulations that link a large number of variables in a complex and evolving way. Greater precision and realism are possible when one describes market activities in terms of assemblages. However, if one stuck only to this description, it would be impossible to explain what collective action involves. These difficulties can easily be overcome if one reintroduces into the analysis what the term “assemblage” tends to remove. The question of framings is at the heart of my description of market agencements. I insisted, for example, on the asymmetry between goods (framed to act passively) and the agencies that evaluate them. I also described in detail the skills and equipment of qualculating agencies, the courses of action implied by organizing meetings and the manufacturing of attachments, and the part formulas play in the pragmatics of pricing. This simple enumeration shows that the notion of arrangement (or of assemblage) is not enough if one wants to take collective action into account, a collective action that is endlessly put into words and is in no way anarchic or chaotic. In an assemblage, entities are, so to speak, left to their own devices. They act lawlessly, desperately, and irremediably, generating untold turmoil. Market agencements, on the other hand, are structured by framings that format the courses of action, all the while being what is at stake in the action. This brings us back to Foucault’s intuition, notably, the idea that action is driven by strategic aims — in this case, instituting bilateral transactions. The formulation and signification of these aims change over time, but they guide and give meaning to the action.

本书所提供的分析，与集合体的一般定义是相容的。在这里，人们可以找到异质要素、话语与物质实体的纠缠、每一个要素遵循自身轨迹并进入其他集合体、以及反过来被当作一个集合体加以分析的可能性。纷繁涌动的互动，以及不存在简单、单义的决定这一状况，在这里也同样可见。例如，定价就是诸多构式的结果，这些构式以复杂而演变的方式把大量变量联系起来。当人们以集合体来描述市场活动时，更高的精确性与现实性是可以达到的。然而，如果仅仅停留于这种描述，就不可能解释集体行动究竟涉及什么。只要把“集合体”一词倾向于移除的东西重新引入分析，这些困难便不难克服。框定问题正是我对市场装配之描述的核心。例如，我曾坚持物品（被框定为被动地行动）与评价它们的能动者之间的不对称。我也详细描述过质算能动者的技能与装备、组织相遇与制造附着所蕴含的行动过程，以及公式在定价的语用学中所起的作用。这一简单的列举表明，若要考虑集体行动——一种不断被付诸言辞、且绝非无政府或混乱的集体行动——安排（或集合体）这一概念是不够的。在一个集合体中，诸实体可以说被听任自行其是。它们无法无天、不顾一切、无可挽回地行动，制造出难以言说的混乱。相反，市场装配则由框定所结构化，这些框定格式化行动过程，同时又本身就是行动中的利害所在。这把我们带回福柯的直觉，尤其是这一观念：行动由战略目标所驱动——在此即设立双边交易。这些目标的表述与意涵随时间而变，但它们引导行动并赋予行动以意义。
THERE ARE NO MARKET AGENCEMENTS WITHOUT NONMARKET AGENCEMENTS
没有非市场装配，就没有市场装配

Let us take the example of personalized medicine in the pharmaceutical industry, which we have already examined in previous chapters. It involves agencements whose strategic goal is to design and offer personalized treatment (as medicine or a form of care), the elaboration of which requires a great number of varied agencies intervening at different moments in the process of qualifying and defining therapies. We saw that the expression “translational” medicine, coined by specialists in the field, is a good summary of one of the problems raised by the number of players, all very different from one another. The sites where therapies are elaborated, tested, and manufactured, in short, where they are qualified and requalified, include university laboratories, investment funds, hospitals, research and development departments, Big Pharmas and their strategic management, and patient groups. These sites are linked through various connections of varying strengths and different natures. The challenge for the market agencement is to favor relations between these sites in such a way as to mobilize skills without which new therapies would not see the light of day without losing sight of the fact that the endgame is to provide a service in exchange for a satisfactory monetary compensation. It is appropriate to speak of “translational” medicine, since the term underlines the need to establish continuity in the collective action of the market while favoring contributions to and enrichments of the design of treatments that are increasingly well adapted to patients.

我们以制药业中的个性化医疗为例，前几章已对此作过考察。它涉及这样一些装配：其战略目标是设计与提供个性化治疗（作为药物或一种照护形式），而这一治疗的精心打造，需要众多各不相同的能动者在治疗品质界定与定义的过程中于不同时刻介入。我们看到，该领域专家所铸造的“转化”（translational）医学这一说法，很好地概括了由参与者数量众多——且彼此差异极大——所引出的问题之一。治疗得以被打造、检验与生产——简言之，得以被品质界定与重新界定品质——的场所，包括大学实验室、投资基金、医院、研发部门、大型制药公司及其战略管理层，以及患者团体。这些场所通过各种强弱不等、性质各异的联系连接起来。市场装配所面临的挑战在于，以某种方式促进这些场所之间的关系，从而动员起那些不可或缺的技能——没有这些技能，新疗法便无从问世——同时又不忘记终局在于提供服务，以换取令人满意的金钱补偿。说“转化”医学是恰当的，因为该词强调：必须在市场的集体行动中建立连续性，同时促进对治疗设计的贡献与充实，使治疗越来越适配患者。

In order to understand how the different framings contribute to feeding and structuring collective action in such a way as to institute bilateral commercial transactions — that is to say, to be open to contributions without losing sight of the final goal, it is useful to introduce two complementary notions, those of
alignment
and
articulation

. These notions will allow us to pull together certain of the observations detailed in the preceding chapters. With them, we can describe market agencements as multisite networks while accounting for their dynamism oriented toward the institution of bilateral transactions and the competition that supposes in view of creating attachments and imposing prices on the transactions.
为了理解不同的框定如何滋养并结构化集体行动，从而建立起双边商业交易——也就是说，既对贡献保持开放，又不偏离最终目标——引入两个互补的概念是有益的：对齐（
alignment
）与接合（
articulation
）。这两个概念将使我们能够把前几章详述的某些观察整合起来。借助它们，我们可以把市场装配描述为多场所网络（multisite networks），同时说明其动态：这种动态朝向双边交易的建立，也朝向由此所预设的竞争——这种竞争着眼于建立附着并对交易施加价格。
ALIGNMENT

Let us take the case of biotech companies in search of potential investors and their collaborations with big pharmaceutical laboratories. One of the sites for such searches is biotech conferences, where meetings are organized between candidates who might eventually cooperate. As we have seen, these meetings formally correspond to encountering, one of the five framings that prepare a market transaction. In her research, sociologist Liliana Doganova has further shown that they also provide a chance for biotech companies to:
a) ensure that everything has been done to verify the nontoxicity of the molecules (passiva(c)tion),
b) evaluate the qualities of the treatment,
c) convince a big pharmaceutical company they are worthy of attachment, and

d) prepare the price formulation. In other words, within a perfectly circumscribed spatiotemporal frame, the other four framings that contribute to realizing the end bilateral transaction with patients are aligned and prepared. Of course, nothing is definitively settled in that place at that time. In other places and at other moments — that is to say, on other sites — the evaluations will be made again, new meetings will be organized, and so on. However, between these sites, the need to take into account the necessary alignment of the five framings, or to put it simply, the goal of reaching a bilateral transaction, will have been taken into account. The translation implies that “translational” medicine is thus initiated and pursued at each site of the market agencement, from beginning to end, from the bench top to the patient’s bed. The final goal, to align the framings, remains in focus at each moment.
对齐
让我们以寻找潜在投资者的生物技术公司及其与大型制药实验室的合作为例。此类寻找的场所之一是生物技术会议，会上会为可能最终合作的候选者安排会面。如前所见，这些会面在形式上对应于相遇，即准备市场交易的五种框定之一。社会学家莉莉安娜·多甘诺娃（Liliana Doganova）在其研究中进一步表明，这些会面也为生物技术公司提供了机会：
a) 确保已尽一切努力验证分子的无毒性（被动化）；
b) 评价治疗的品质；
c) 说服大型制药公司相信自己值得附着；

d) 准备价格构式。换言之，在一个完全被划定的时空框架内，有助于实现与患者的最终双边交易的另外四种框定被对齐并准备就绪。当然，在那个地点、那个时刻，一切都尚未最终确定。在其他地点、其他时刻——也就是在其他场所——评价将重新进行，新的会面将被组织，如此等等。然而，在这些场所之间，必须考虑五种框定之必要对齐这一要求，或者简单说，达成双边交易这一目标，将已被纳入考虑。这种转译意味着，“转化”医学因此在市场装配的每一个场所、从始至终、从实验台到患者床边，被启动并持续推进。对齐诸框定这一最终目标，在每一时刻都保持在焦点之中。

The medical example helps show that alignment can be obtained in a thousand different ways. In the case of therapeutic innovation, one has thus moved from the pipeline model to the translation model. The pipeline model, which remains the most widespread, points to the obstacle course a molecule must follow, progressively and sequentially, from the laboratory site to the hospital site. At each step, the molecule is requalified. After in vitro tests, one moves to animal testing, then to evaluating the therapeutic potential and then the nontoxicity of the molecule on human beings, all to verify that it treats patients in a satisfactory way. There are few steps backward, few sites involved. With the translational model, there are many steps back, many iterations and feedback loops, and the number of sites increases.

Aligning framings when there are numerous sites is a complicated task, one that requires more finesse and subtlety, as well as more discipline, than when there are only a few sites and agencies. With the proliferation of groups and stakes, the management and organization of translational medicine is an ongoing challenge.

医学例子有助于表明，对齐可以以千百种方式获得。就治疗创新而言，人们已从管线模型（pipeline model）转向转译模型（translation model）。管线模型仍最为流行，它指的是一个分子从实验室场所到医院场所必须依次逐步经历的重重障碍。每一步，分子都被重新界定品质。体外试验之后，进入动物试验，然后评价分子的治疗潜力，再评价其对人的无毒性，这一切都是为了验证它以令人满意的方式治疗患者。回退的步骤很少，涉及的场所也很少。而在转译模型中，回退的步骤很多，迭代与反馈回路很多，场所的数量也增加。
当场所众多时，对齐诸框定是一项复杂的任务，比起只有少数场所与能动者的情形，它需要更多的精细与微妙，也需要更多的纪律。随着群体与利害的增殖，转化医学的管理与组织成为一项持续的挑战。

This challenge is all the greater because the translation model takes the lead in a growing proportion of commercial activities. Because of the adjustments it implies, the singularization of goods, which starts very early in research and development departments, requires ever more agencies, interactions, and iterations. The inventory of sites in play that have to be aligned is not limited to the traditional phases of design, manufacture, and distribution. These distinctions blur. For instance, sites linked to consumption cannot be kept away from the process of goods’ qualification and the preparation of the commercial transaction. Any subscriber to
Que choisir
and any internet user who answers a satisfaction survey, any member of a fan club or user group, any patient belonging to a patient group, is involved in the alignment process.
这一挑战之所以更为艰巨，是因为转译模型在越来越大比例的商业活动中占据主导。由于它所带来的调整，物品的独一化——它在研发部门很早就已开始——需要越来越多的能动者、互动与迭代。必须加以对齐的在场场所清单，并不局限于设计、制造与分销这些传统阶段。这些区分正在模糊。例如，与消费相联系的场所不能被排除在物品品质界定过程与商业交易准备之外。任何《选择》（
Que choisir
）的订户、任何回答满意度调查的网民、任何粉丝俱乐部或用户团体的成员、任何属于患者团体的患者，都参与到对齐过程之中。

The final achievement of alignment comes about with price formulation. By establishing relations between the different evaluations, intermediary and prosthetic prices, price formulation establishes a connection between all of the sites involved in the collective action. It plays a crucial role in the orientation of the agencement toward market action. Economic theory’s intuition that prices sum up the way the market works is not wrong. It’s not that they convey all available information — who could verify such a claim? Prices simply say that a whole set of operations that took place during the qualification of the good on the various sites through which it passed has been taken into account, but in a way that is obviously open to discussion and controversy. Prices take hold of that story and summarize it in such a way that it can continue — that is to say, in order to give the good a chance to pursue its career by changing hands once the transaction has been completed. Alignment, like the formulation itself, is a
coup de force
that can be subverted and reversed.

对齐的最终完成，伴随着价格构式而到来。价格构式通过在不同评价、中间价格与义肢性价格之间建立关系，在参与集体行动的所有场所之间建立起联系。它对于装配朝向市场行动的定向起着关键作用。经济理论关于价格概括了市场运作方式的直觉并没有错。问题不在于价格传达了所有可得信息——谁又能验证这样的主张呢？价格只是表明：物品在其所经过的各个场所被品质界定的过程中所发生的一整套操作已被纳入考虑，但显然是以一种可以讨论、可以争议的方式。价格抓住那段故事，并把它概括起来，使之得以继续——也就是说，让物品有机会在交易完成之后易手，从而继续其生涯。对齐，就像构式本身一样，是一种强力之举（
coup de force
），可以被颠覆、被逆转。

One of the most striking illustrations of the conflicts and controversies that alignment provokes involves the modes in which market agencements mobilize academic research. Many estimate that too strict an alignment puts science itself in peril, threatening its capacity to open new avenues of research and to serve the general interest. Should the cost of the fundamental research that makes possible its development and manufacture be included in the cost of medicine, accepting by the same token that fundamental research be submitted to market forces? Or should fundamental science be financed independently (for instance, through taxes) so as to allow it to explore new paths and produce knowledge that can be used for free by any economic agent and whose cost of production does not appear in the price of medicine? However much of a caricature, this alternative shows the link between pricing and alignment. The two therapeutic models evoked earlier, the pipeline model and translation, illustrate the tension. In the first case, the sequential alignment can accommodate divergent academic research, as long as the possibility that a handful of molecules makes it to the end of the pipeline is preserved. In the second case, the dynamics of iterations and other loops gives impetus to academic research, which is thereby more closely aligned with Big Pharmas and the demands of patients, given the links with start-ups, patient groups, and consortiums of university laboratories. Price formulation becomes more conflictual, notably with the controversial and complicated qualculation of academic contributions.

对齐所引发的冲突与争议，最引人注目的例证之一，涉及市场装配动员学术研究的方式。许多人认为，过于严格的对齐会使科学本身陷入危险，威胁它开辟新研究路径、服务普遍利益的能力。是否应当把使其开发与制造得以可能的基础研究的成本计入药物成本，并因此接受基础研究受制于市场力量？还是应当独立地资助基础科学（例如通过税收），让它探索新路径、生产任何经济行动者都可免费使用的知识，而其生产成本并不出现在药物价格之中？无论这一选择多么像漫画式夸张，它都显示出了定价与对齐之间的联系。前面提到的两种治疗模型——管线模型与转译模型——说明了这种张力。在第一种情形中，顺序式对齐可以容纳方向各异的学术研究，只要保留少数分子能走到管线尽头的可能性即可。在第二种情形中，迭代及其他回路的动态为学术研究提供了动力，而由于与初创企业、患者团体和大学实验室联合体的联系，学术研究因此与大型制药公司及患者的要求更为紧密地对齐。价格构式变得更具冲突性，尤其是在对学术贡献进行颇具争议且复杂的质算之时。
ARTICULATION

An agencement cannot be reduced to a list of sites connected to one another, protected by a border that could be considered to separate what is internal to the agencement and what is external. Foucault and Deleuze underline this point, Foucault when he speaks of networks, Deleuze when he evokes lines of flight. An agencement (whether market, political, technical, artistic, or religious) cannot be compared to Europe’s Schengen Area, with its free circulation within its borders and its controls over exchanges with the outside. It can function and be extended only if it is vascularized — that is to say, enriched with continuous contributions and therefore open to other sites and agencements. This requirement of openness guarantees the agencement’s capacity for innovation, for renewing and extending bilateral transactions.
接合

装配不能被化约为一份彼此相连的场所清单，由一条边界保护着，仿佛这条边界可以区分装配内部之物与外部之物。福柯与德勒兹强调了这一点：福柯谈到网络，德勒兹则提到逃逸线。装配（无论是市场的、政治的、技术的、艺术的还是宗教的）不能比作欧洲的申根区——在其边界内自由流通，并对与外部之间的交换实施管控。它只有被血管化——也就是说，被持续不断的贡献所充实，因而向其他场所与其他装配开放——才能运作并扩展。这种开放性的要求，保障了装配创新、更新并扩展双边交易的能力。

Even when the alignment of the different sites and activities that contribute to the commercial action is carried to its extreme, we should not forget that each site and activity is also caught up, at the same time, in other collective actions, in other types of agencements. As we have seen, openness to the outside is one of the essential characteristics of assemblages, and it is a characteristic shared by agencements. In sum, the same activities can be multiframed. For example, a university scientist who, in the framework of a financed contract, works on a project in collaboration with a company’s production engineers or salespeople is part of a market agencement, yet his activity is also involved in agencements that can be called scientific insofar as they participate in a collective action that produces statements that can be contested, disproved, or validated by colleagues. Furthermore, the same research activity may be simultaneously oriented toward altruistic relations — such as when the scientist receives gifts for the research or transmits materials or lines of code to a colleague or a partner — or toward ethical preoccupations, as when he hesitates to develop certain lines of research for moral reasons. Consumers, too, can be multiframed: they can buy a package from a telecom provider as a gift for someone, or if they are handy, divert bandwidth to construct a private surveillance apparatus. Likewise, an engineer who perfects a cogenerator and aims to optimize its economic viability does not thereby give up concern for work well done; he may be involved with communities of experts who value the effi -ciency of the machines they design. As we saw in Chapter 6, it can even be that company economists, whose task is to maximize returns on investments, introduce political concerns into the price formulations they suggest. These tensions are the rule, not the exception. They have been described a thousand times by the sociology of professions, moral and political sociology, and the sociology of organizations. Research in these fields provides repeated reminders that a single logic of action cannot, on its own, account for the richness and complexity of practices. The notion of agencement proves necessary in order to understand distributed and strategically oriented collective action, as well as the active role of the material environment. It does not erase these tensions. Rather, it leads to modifying the interpretations invoked to account for them.

即使有助于商业行动的不同场所与活动的对齐被推向极致，我们也不应忘记，每一个场所与活动同时也被卷入其他集体行动、其他类型的装配之中。如前所见，向外部开放是集合体的基本特征之一，而装配也共享这一特征。总之，同样的活动可以是多重框定的。例如，一位大学科学家在受资助合同的框架内，与一家公司的生产工程师或销售人员合作开展项目，他属于一个市场装配，但他的活动同时也卷入可称为科学的装配，因为这些装配参与一种集体行动，生产出可被同行质疑、否证或验证的陈述。此外，同一项研究活动可能同时朝向利他关系——比如科学家为研究而接受馈赠，或把材料或代码行传给同事或合作伙伴——或朝向伦理关切，比如他出于道德理由而犹豫是否发展某些研究路线。消费者同样可以是多重框定的：他们可以从电信运营商那里购买套餐送给某人，或者，如果他们手巧，还可以挪用带宽来构建一套私人监视装置。同样，一位完善热电联产机组并致力于优化其经济可行性的工程师，并不会因此放弃对出色工作的关切；他可能参与一些专家共同体，而这些共同体看重他们所设计机器的效率。正如我们在第六章所见，甚至可能出现这样的情况：公司经济学家——其任务是使投资回报最大化——在所建议的价格构式中引入政治关切。这些张力是常态，而非例外。职业社会学、道德与政治社会学以及组织社会学已千百次地描述过它们。这些领域的研究一再提醒我们：单一的行动逻辑本身无法解释实践的丰富性与复杂性。装配这一概念之所以必要，是为了理解分布式的、具有战略定向的集体行动，以及物质环境的能动作用。它并不消除这些张力。相反，它导致人们修改用来解释这些张力的阐释。

An academic researcher involved in an industrial project is not required to reconcile demands imposed from the outside (nor does he impose such a requirement on himself). His activities are formatted by the different agencements in which he is a player: the objects on which he works, and therefore the work itself, are framed by the multiple, distributed collective actions with which they are associated. When he studies a cellular mechanism for blocking the growth of cancerous tumors, the object he manipulates and that he analyzes is profiled simultaneously by the search for a medical treatment that a creditworthy client will not be able to do without and by the production of statements that can withstand scientific critique and objections. The same analysis can be applied to all of the agencies involved in a market agencement. The formula that an economist-engineer develops can take into account, in its very expression, the capture of a client and the search for social justice, as in the case of establishing electricity prices. These few examples, which should be subject to systematic analyses, show that in each of these sites, a market agencement is articulated year in and year out with other types of agencements (technical, scientific, ethical) and that this articulation is at stake in the very modalities of framing — that is to say, in the form given to cellular mechanisms in biology, mobile telephones, cogeneration, or price formulation. The work that goes into this shaping is itself an object worthy of research; such research might, for instance, identify the conditions under which one agencement locally wins out over the others with which it is articulated. For my purposes in this chapter, suffice it to emphasize that a market agencement is always intertwined with other types of agencements. Given the growing multiplicity of sites it connects, a market agencement may give the illusion that the market is everywhere. However, this is indeed an illusion, since it is grappling with other modes of agencement within each of those sites. A market agencement does not develop within a territory, but instead according to a topography or geometry reminiscent of fractals.

一位参与产业项目的学术研究者，并不被要求调和从外部强加的要求（他也不给自己施加这样的要求）。他的活动由他所参与的不同装配加以格式化：他所处理的对象，因而工作本身，被与它们相关联的多种分布式集体行动所框定。当他研究一种阻断癌性肿瘤生长的细胞机制时，他所操作并分析的对象，同时受到两方面的塑形：一是寻找一种有支付能力的客户不可或缺的医学治疗，二是生产经得起科学批判与反驳的陈述。同样的分析可以应用于参与市场装配的所有能动者。一位工程师—经济学家所制定的公式，可以在其表述本身之中同时纳入对客户的捕获与对社会正义的追寻，就像在确立电价的情形中那样。这几个例子——它们理应成为系统分析的对象——表明，在这些场所中的每一处，市场装配年复一年地与其他类型的装配（技术的、科学的、伦理的）相接合，而这种接合恰恰攸关框定的具体方式——也就是说，攸关赋予生物学中的细胞机制、移动电话、热电联产或价格构式的形式。这种形塑所投入的工作本身就是一个值得研究的对象；例如，此类研究可以识别出一个装配在本地压过与它相接合的其他装配的条件。就本章的目的而言，只需强调：市场装配总是与其他类型的装配交织在一起。鉴于它所连接的场所日益增多，市场装配可能给人一种市场无处不在的幻觉。然而，这确实是一种幻觉，因为它在每一个场所内部都与其他装配方式相搏斗。市场装配不是在某个领土之内发展，而是依照一种令人联想到分形的地形学或几何学来发展。

Each site that participates in the alignment of the activities of a market agencement is traversed by one or several borders. Jane Guyer talks of margins to refer to these articulations that traverse each site, adding that gains are made only at the margins. Increases in values are fed by the collision of differences in evaluation.
参与市场装配之活动对齐的每一个场所，都被一条或数条边界穿过。简·盖耶（Jane Guyer）用“边缘”（margins）一词来指这些穿过每个场所的接合，并补充说，收益只在边缘处获得。价值的增长由评价差异的碰撞所滋养。
TRANSACTION-FREE ZONES

On the one hand, the agencement closes in on itself and its strategic aim of instituting bilateral market transactions. On the other hand, it opens onto other types of agencement that provide the resources and energy it needs. Here again, we find the tension generated by familiar oppositions, just as commercial and noncommercial activities are known to complement and nourish each other. Yet there is an essential difference. In the case of market agencements, rather than being established between spheres, fields, or worlds that remain exterior to one another, complementarity is obtained locally, site by site. This raises the question of the overall architecture and the organization of activities. How are alignment and articulation made compatible, despite the fact they tend to be in opposition at any given site?
无交易区

一方面，装配封闭于自身及其建立双边市场交易的战略目标；另一方面，它向其他类型的装配开放，后者提供它所需要的资源与能量。在这里，我们再次遇到由熟悉的二元对立所产生的张力，正如人们知道商业活动与非商业活动彼此补充、相互滋养。然而有一个本质区别。就市场装配而言，互补性并非在始终彼此外在的领域、场域或世界之间建立，而是在本地、逐个场所地获得。这引出了整体架构与活动组织的问题。尽管在任何给定场所，对齐与接合往往相互对立，它们又如何能够相容？

There is, as far as I know, no satisfying answer to this question. To give a hint at a plausible solution, let’s turn to Carliss Baldwin and her concept of a transaction-free zone, which, as the name implies, is a zone in which commercial transactions do not occur.
据我所知，这个问题没有令人满意的答案。为了提示一种可能的解决办法，让我们转向卡丽丝·鲍德温（Carliss Baldwin）及其“无交易区”（transaction-free zone）概念；顾名思义，这是一个不发生商业交易的区域。

To illustrate this notion, the easiest way is to consider an example, say, a center for scientific research that wishes to participate in both industrial and academic life. This double affiliation leads it to participate in communities of experts and in the advancement of knowledge while also becoming part of the commercial world and its activities. Its involvement in economic life may be sporadic and minimal, similar to a laboratory for fundamental research that simply buys equipment or recruits researchers and technicians on the job market. Its involvement may also be constant and substantial, similar to labs that cooperate with a powerful partnering firm on a regular basis. Whichever balance is chosen, the problem and the solution are the same: they have to organize in such a way as to remain compatible with both market agencements and scientific agencements.

为了说明这一概念，最简便的方法是考虑一个例子，比如一个希望同时参与产业生活与学术生活的科学研究中心。这种双重归属使它参与专家共同体与知识推进，同时也进入商业世界及其活动。它对经济生活的参与可能是零星而微小的，类似一个基础研究实验室仅仅购买设备，或从劳动力市场招聘研究人员和技术人员。它的参与也可能是持续而重大的，类似那些与强大合作企业定期合作的实验室。无论选择哪种平衡，问题与解决办法都是一样的：它们必须组织得能够同时与市场装配和科学装配相容。

Such compromises are by no means impossible. Over the last one hundred and fifty years, scientists and industrial players have progressively learned to develop forms of organization that favor this double game. A frequent solution for the links between research centers and industry is a matrix organization, crossing technological and innovation projects. The first organization ensures the articulation with scientific activities, the second with industrial activities. All that remains is to organize the crossovers. (This requires a lot of knowhow and finesse!) Those who loudly clamor that the values and norms of science cannot be reconciled with those of the markets have been proven wrong. The adjustments are made daily and easily through the choice of objects and subjects of research.

这类妥协绝非不可能。在过去一百五十年里，科学家与产业行动者逐渐学会了发展有利于这种双重游戏的组织形式。研究中心与产业之间联系的一种常见解决办法，是矩阵式组织，让技术项目与创新项目彼此交叉。前一方面的组织确保与科学活动的接合，后一方面的组织确保与产业活动的接合。剩下的只是组织交叉点。（这需要大量诀窍与精细功夫！）那些大声疾呼科学的价值观与规范无法与市场的价值观与规范相调和的人，已被证明是错的。调整每天都在进行，并且通过选择研究对象与主题而轻易实现。

One might also cite the case of coders who organize in order to design and produce (so-called) free software, which can be used at no cost by other expert communities and can simultaneously be taken up, with a few contractual arrangements, by commercial entrepreneurs. Or one could cite the example of groups that start by offering services for free and then, once the basic products have been tested, enrich, complete, and transform them into commercial goods. Research centers, expert communities, and nonprofit organizations — all of these are cases of transaction-free zones that are inscribed in commercial alignment strategies while preserving an articulation with other types of agencements.
还可以举出程序员的例子：他们组织起来设计并生产（所谓的）自由软件，这些软件可以被其他专家共同体免费使用，同时也可以经由若干合同安排，被商业创业者接手。或者可以举出这样的群体：它们起初免费提供服务，然后，在基础产品经过测试之后，加以充实、完善，并将其转化为商业物品。研究中心、专家共同体与非营利组织——所有这些都是无交易区的例子，它们被纳入商业对齐策略，同时保持与其他类型装配的接合。

Establishing transaction-free zones is not a new strategy. Depending on the state of development of market agencements and depending on the type of agencements that have to be articulated, they take on various evolving forms. Baldwin suggests an interesting parallel. Observing that the legal status of limited liability companies, only two centuries old, was precisely aimed at creating spaces that would be protected from the market while being caught up in it, she draws a distinction between “encapsulated” and “unencapsulated” transaction-free zones. An incorporated company (a company that is registered and has legal personhood) is encapsulated within borders that ensure a large measure of autonomy, as well as the possibility of being free, internally, from all bilateral transactions. An open-source community is unencapsulated.
In both cases, we have transaction-free zones.

建立无交易区并不是新策略。取决于市场装配的发展状态，也取决于必须加以接合的装配类型，它们采取各种不断演化的形式。鲍德温提出了一个有趣的类比。她观察到，有限责任公司这一法律地位仅有二百年历史，其目的恰恰是创造既受到保护而免于市场直接支配、又被卷入市场的空间，据此区分了“封装的”与“非封装的”无交易区。一家注册公司（一家经注册并具有法人资格的公司）被封装在边界之内，这些边界确保其很大程度的自主性，以及内部免于一切双边交易的可能性。一个开源共同体则是非封装的。
在两种情况下，我们都有无交易区。

A transaction-free zone does not directly depend on its shareholders. (If a shareholder is in debt, the firm is not affected, and, conversely, the shareholders are liable only within the limits of the shares they hold.) The only requirement a free zone of this type faces is that of its own survival and its own financing, which is made possible through its articulation with commercial activities. In this case, the form of organization is generally what economists call “hierarchical.” It is designed to ensure, insofar as possible, the unity of action of the collective that is the incorporated firm. By analogy, and to designate the free zones that ensure a living environment for expert communities cooperating to elaborate goods that will then also enter commercial transactions, one can speak of “unencapsulated firms,” since these communities have neither legal personhood nor national affiliations.

无交易区并不直接依赖于其股东。（如果股东负债，公司不受影响；反过来，股东仅以其所持股份为限承担责任。）这类无交易区所面临的唯一要求，是自身生存与自身融资，而这通过它与商业活动的接合而成为可能。在这种情况下，组织形式一般是经济学家所谓的“科层式”。它旨在尽可能确保作为注册公司的集体之行动的统一。依此类推，为了指称那些为合作打造物品的专家共同体确保生活环境的无交易区——这些物品随后也将进入商业交易——人们可以说“非封装企业”，因为这些共同体既无法人资格，也无国族归属。

The establishment of free zones maintains the vascularization of market agencements while contributing to the pursuit of commercial collective action. Of course, questions of costs, technical coherence, and moral preferences come into play, but only as secondary considerations, in order to draw the borders more precisely.
The existence and constitution of free zones arise from a higher imperative: no commercial transactions without openings toward the activities that nourish and renew them.
无交易区的建立维持了市场装配的血管化，同时有助于商业集体行动的推进。当然，成本、技术一致性与道德偏好等问题会起作用，但只是作为次要考虑，为的是更精确地划定边界。
无交易区的存在与构成源于一项更高的律令：没有对滋养并更新商业交易的活动保持开放，就没有商业交易。

The constitution of unencapsulated free zones, zones that are free from all internal commercial transactions and that are not companies, is becoming common with the development of market agencements that include and mobilize a growing number of heterogeneous sites, which each provide occasions for articulations with other noncommercial agencements. The activities connected to exploiting and commercializing products derived from blood provide a striking example of this. As Philippe Steiner has convincingly showed, blood donation mixes and articulates activities that prohibit any commercial transaction (one gives blood) with others that are involved in commercializing derivative products (such as plasmas).

However, as an illustration, I will refer instead to sociologist Anissa Pomiès’s work devoted to the emergence of a new market concerning “specialty” coffees because this example brings out free zones’ role outside the technological sectors in which they are usually considered.

非封装无交易区——即免于一切内部商业交易、且并非公司的区域——的构成，正随着市场装配的发展而变得普遍；这些市场装配包含并动员越来越多的异质场所，每一个场所都提供与其他非商业装配相接合的机会。与利用和商业化血液制品相关的活动提供了一个引人注目的例子。正如菲利普·施泰纳（Philippe Steiner）令人信服地表明的，献血把禁止任何商业交易的活动（人们献血）与参与衍生产品（如血浆）商业化的其他活动混合并接合起来。
不过，作为例证，我宁愿转而参考社会学家阿妮萨·波米耶（Anissa Pomiès）关于“精品”咖啡新市场兴起的研究，因为这个例子凸显了无交易区在人们通常考虑的技术部门之外的作用。

A few years ago, the observation that coffee bars serve mediocre coffee led to initiatives to enhance the value of the product. This involved setting up world championships for baristas, those who make and serve coffee, and defining a set of rules to frame the way espressos and cappuccinos are made. A barista who wants a shot at the podium needs to tell the story of the coffee selected (origin, production conditions, taste qualities), choose certain materials, follow a set of rules (grinding specifications, infusion time), offer balanced coffee (neither too bitter nor too acidic), obtain a certain texture for the frothed milk and enhance it with original patterns, and ensure the quality of service by following standards of hygiene and manners. Coffee, thus requalified in four dimensions (narrative, technical, sensorial, and service), bears no resemblance to a standardized product such as the espresso served in Parisian brasseries — robusta, overroasted, bitter, and so on. These competitions frame a qualification that suggests and opens numerous options: the choice of coffee bean, modes of roasting, quantity used, water temperature, color of the crema, and so on. Baristas who follow the formalized procedure set up by the championships in their own coffee shops can subtly adapt to the client and be in a position to argue that it is good coffee. This movement deepens singularization and the tight coprofiling it requires.

几年前，有人观察到咖啡吧供应的咖啡平庸，这促成了提升产品价值的种种举措。这涉及设立咖啡师——即制作并端上咖啡的人——世界锦标赛，并界定一套规则，以框定浓缩咖啡与卡布奇诺的制作方式。想要登上领奖台的咖啡师，需要讲述所选咖啡的故事（产地、生产条件、风味品质），选择特定器具，遵循一套规则（研磨规格、浸泡时间），提供均衡的咖啡（既不过苦，也不过酸），为奶泡获得某种质地并用原创图案加以点缀，并遵循卫生与礼仪标准以确保服务品质。咖啡因此在四个维度（叙事、技术、感官与服务）上被重新界定品质，与巴黎小酒馆里供应的浓缩咖啡——罗布斯塔豆、过度烘焙、苦涩等等——这类标准化产品毫无相似之处。这些竞赛框定了一种品质界定，它提示并开启众多选项：咖啡豆的选择、烘焙方式、用量、水温、克丽玛（crema）的颜色，等等。那些在自己咖啡馆中遵循锦标赛所确立的程式化程序的咖啡师，可以巧妙地适应顾客，并有能力主张这是好咖啡。这一运动深化了独一化，以及独一化所要求的紧密共同塑形。

The championships — there are in fact several, each of which has a slightly different definition of a good coffee’s qualities — exclude any commercial transaction: the coffee made is not sold, and at no point in the preparation is price mentioned — no cost calculation. Money does not count! All the efforts converge to qualify a coffee without a price. These championships are transaction-free zones such as Baldwin describes, which of course exclude neither hierarchies nor power relations: they call on specialized judges and head judges, promulgate rules and charters, demand docile submission from baristas, and crown it all with a score on which the final ranking is based. This score is later used on commercial sites as one of the variables taken into account in price formulation. A barista who has participated in the championships or watched them on television, another who has talked to colleagues or taken classes to prepare for them, can qualculate the price asked of his client by referring to the scores that “impartial” judges have given to different profiles of espressos or cappuccinos. The formula that is finally chosen can, again using scores produced outside commercial sites, take into account the evaluations made by other transaction-free zones, such as roasting championships, classes, or clubs. The multiple and heterogeneous articulation gives dynamism to the whole. The communities of amateurs that take shape and gravitate around free zones can verify that the qualifications elaborated there have some connection to the average consumer. As for the market agencements, they are nourished by the participation of free zones in the network.

这些锦标赛——实际上有好几个，每个对好咖啡品质的定义都略有不同——排除任何商业交易：制作的咖啡不出售，在制作过程的任何时刻都不提及价格——没有成本计算。金钱不算数！所有努力都汇聚于界定一种没有价格的咖啡。这些锦标赛就是鲍德温所描述的那种无交易区，当然，它们既不排除等级制，也不排除权力关系：它们召请专业评委与首席评委，颁布规则与章程，要求咖啡师驯顺服从，并以一个作为最终排名依据的分数为这一切加冕。这个分数随后在商业场所被用作价格构式所考虑的变量之一。一位参加过锦标赛或在电视上观看过锦标赛的咖啡师，另一位与同事交谈过或上过备赛课程的咖啡师，可以参照“公正”评委对具有不同特征构型的浓缩咖啡或卡布奇诺给出的分数，来质算向顾客索取的价格。最终选定的公式，同样可以利用在商业场所之外产生的分数，把其他无交易区——如烘焙锦标赛、课程或俱乐部——所作的评价纳入考虑。这种多重而异质的接合赋予整体以动态。围绕无交易区形成并运转的爱好者共同体，可以验证在那里形成的品质界定与普通消费者有某种关联。至于市场装配，它们则从无交易区参与网络中获得滋养。

Transaction-free zones reconcile the contradictory requirements of articulation and alignment. They frame, prepare, and vascularize, interrupting the work of alignment without thereby excluding it. The very dynamism of market agencements is at stake; this reconciliation impacts their capacity to renew themselves, transform themselves, and make novel transactions and new forms of activity emerge. Commercial and noncommercial activities are complementary, not substitutes for one another. The complementarity takes different forms and is expressed in various ways. Anthropologist Anna Tsing provides the illustration of one possible configuration in her amazing book devoted to the career of the matsutake mushroom, which is harvested by communities of gatherers in Oregon, then is transferred into Japanese commercial circuits in order to satisfy customers who stop at nothing to get hold of it; the mushroom is sometimes transformed into gifts and is constantly observed by scientific communities.

To characterize this configuration, Tsing uses notions such as “patch,” which refers to the different communities through which the mushroom travels, or “recycling” to describe the metamorphoses of the matsutake as it moves from one continent to another against the backdrop of capitalism in ruins. To feed, perpetuate, and extend itself, this ruined capitalism captures activities that take place well beyond its borders, in a world in which everyone is trying to survive in their own way, including by shamelessly pillaging natural resources. One could generalize from Tsing’s analysis and show how, from the perspective of market agencies, research laboratories, communities of geeks, or free software advocates get exploited and how they react against this influence. This tension is at the heart of market agencements.

无交易区调和了接合与对齐这两种相互矛盾的要求。它们框定、准备并使之血管化，中断对齐的工作，却并不因此排除它。市场装配的动态本身正系于此；这种调和影响着它们自我更新、自我转化以及催生新颖交易与新活动形式的能力。商业活动与非商业活动是互补的，而不是彼此的替代。互补性采取不同形式，并以各种方式表达。人类学家罗安清（Anna Tsing）在她那部关于松茸生涯的精彩著作中，提供了一种可能构型的例证：松茸由俄勒冈的采集者共同体采得，随后转入日本商业流通渠道，以满足那些不惜一切代价要得到它的顾客；松茸有时被转化为礼物，并始终受到科学共同体的观察。

为了刻画这一构型，罗安清使用了诸如“斑块”（patch）这样的概念——它指松茸所穿行的不同共同体——以及“回收”（recycling），用以描述松茸在一块大陆到另一块大陆之间、以废墟中的资本主义为背景所发生的变形。为了滋养、延续并扩展自身，这种废墟资本主义捕获了远在其边界之外发生的活动——在这个世界里，每个人都在以自己的方式求生，包括毫不羞耻地掠夺自然资源。人们可以从罗安清的分析出发加以推广，表明从市场能动者的视角看，研究实验室、极客共同体或自由软件倡导者如何被剥削，以及他们如何反抗这种影响。这种张力正是市场装配的核心。

Tsing’s terminology is well suited to situations in which the commercial and noncommercial activities show strong exteriority. However, to give a fully general description of the different configurations, which are more and more often characterized by a high level of entanglement, I prefer recourse to the notion of “free zone.” The complementary notions of alignment and articulation also seem more correct and relevant to the model of market agencements. Depending on the configuration, the lifestyles differ (some free zones favor relations of solidarity, others hierarchical relations), and so do the dynamic of concerns and confrontations (some play on cooperation, others on contestation).
罗安清的术语很适合商业活动与非商业活动表现出强烈外在性的情境。然而，为了充分一般地描述各种构型——它们越来越常常以高度纠缠为特征——我更愿意借助“无交易区”这一概念。对齐与接合这对互补概念，对于市场装配模型来说也显得更为正确、更为贴切。取决于构型不同，生活方式也不同（有些无交易区偏爱团结关系，另一些则偏爱等级关系），关切与对抗的动态同样不同（有些倚重合作，另一些则倚重抗争）。
THE DYNAMICS OF CONCERNS
关切的动态

Market agencements are machineries whose aim is to find regular and satisfying solutions to the strategic problem of instituting and multiplying commercial bilateral transactions. The thesis developed in this book is that the result is obtained by deploying a (distributed) collective action structured by a series of five framings and that it takes the form of a multisited network that organizes their alignment and their articulations. These networks can be described as innovation networks in competition with one another.
市场装配是一些机器装置，其目标是为设立并倍增商业双边交易这一战略问题找到稳定而令人满意的解决办法。本书所展开的论点是：这一结果是通过部署一种由一系列五重框定所结构化的（分布式）集体行动而获得的；这种行动采取多地点网络的形式，而该网络组织诸框定之间的对齐与接合。这些网络可以被描述为彼此竞争的创新网络。

Agencements are in constant motion. They are animated by forces. Some of these forces tend to reinforce and reproduce existing framings, whereas others tend, on the contrary, to transform them. Whether they are positive or negative, whether they overthrow or consolidate existing arrangements, these forces are at the heart of agencements. To understand how they function, one needs to introduce a notion with which the reader is by now familiar: the source of concern or problems. As we have seen throughout this book, framings produce matters of concern. None of the framings is so perfect as to avoid overflowing. Entities that participate in different courses of action always at least partially escape the predictable and disciplined behavior one would like to impose on them. They cause trouble, which reaches other entities and pushes them to (re)act.

装配始终处于运动之中。它们被各种力量所驱动。有些力量倾向于强化并再生产既有的框定，另一些力量则相反，倾向于转化这些框定。无论这些力量是积极的还是消极的，无论它们推翻还是巩固既有安排，它们都处于装配的核心。要理解装配如何运作，就需要引入一个读者如今已经熟悉的概念：关切或问题的来源。正如我们在本书通篇所见，框定生产关切事项。没有任何一种框定完美到可以避免溢出。参与不同行动进程的实体，总是至少部分地逃脱人们想要强加于它们的可预测、守纪律的行为。它们制造麻烦，麻烦波及别的实体，并推动后者行动或作出反应。
A wonderful illustration of this process linking actions and reactions can be found in La Fontaine’s famous fable “The Cobbler and the Financier” — not unrelated to the subject of this book.
这一把行动与反应联结起来的过程，在拉封丹（Jean de La Fontaine）那则著名寓言《补鞋匠与金融家》（“The Cobbler and the Financier”）中得到了绝妙的例示——这则寓言与本书的主题并非无关。
A cobbler sang from morn till night;
’Twas sweet and marvellous to hear
His neighbour, on the other hand
With gold in plenty at command
But little sang, and slumber’d less —
A financier of great success.
If e’er he dozed, at break of day
The cobbler’s song drove sleep away
And much he wish’d that Heaven had made
Sleep a commodity of trade
In market sold, like food and drink.
补鞋匠从早唱到晚；
歌声甜美，令人惊叹。
他的邻居却不然，
手中掌握着充裕的黄金，
却很少歌唱，觉也睡得更少——
一位极为成功的金融家。
他若在破晓时分打盹，
鞋匠的歌声便驱走睡意，
于是他多么希望上天
把睡眠造成一种交易的商品，
像食物与饮水一样在市场上出售。

La Fontaine sets the scene between two agencies whose activities enter into conflict with one another. The cobbler is a permanent problem, a source of constant concern for his rich neighbor. The latter, used to buying and selling everything, would like to transform sleep into a commodity and enter into a bilateral commercial transaction with the cobbler. This dream is not impossible (as the French term for “slumlord” shows: “marchands de sommeil” are literally sleep merchants). However, the fable’s financier lives in a world in which sleep is not yet a commodity. He therefore chooses to go see his neighbor and inquire what troubles him. He quickly learns that the poor cobbler’s constant worry, his main existential problem, is how to procure his daily bread. This is not a chance to be missed. The financier immediately says to the cobbler:

拉封丹把场景置于两个能动者之间，二者的活动彼此冲突。鞋匠是一个持续存在的问题，是他那位富有的邻居不断关切的来源。后者习惯于买卖一切，他巴不得把睡眠变成一种商品，与鞋匠缔结一笔双边商业交易。这个梦想并非不可能（法语中“贫民窟房东”一词便表明了这一点：“marchands de sommeil”字面意思就是“睡眠商人”）。然而，寓言中的金融家生活在一个睡眠尚未成为商品的世界里。因此，他选择去见自己的邻居，询问是什么在困扰他。他很快得知，这个可怜鞋匠持续的忧虑、他主要的存在问题，就是如何弄到每天的面包。这个机会不能错过。金融家立刻对鞋匠说：
These hundred pounds I hand you here
Will make you happy as a king.
Go, spend them with a frugal heed;
They’ll long supply your every need.
这一百镑，我在此交到你手上，
会让你像国王一样快乐。
去吧，节俭谨慎地花用；
它们将长久满足你的一切所需。

Freed from daily torment, the cobbler rejoices. He goes home and hides the silver there. “And,” as La Fontaine puts it, “with it laid his joy aside. / No more of song, no more of sleep, / But cares, suspicions in their stead.” Unable to stand it any longer, he rushes back to the financier, begging him to take back his money and to return his songs and his sleep.
摆脱了日常的折磨，鞋匠欣喜万分。他回到家中，把银钱藏在那里。正如拉封丹所写：“而随着银钱放下，他的快乐也被搁在一旁。/ 不再有歌声，不再有睡眠，/ 取而代之的是忧虑与猜疑。”再也无法忍受下去，他跑回金融家那里，求他收回钱，把自己的歌声与睡眠还给他。

This edifying fable brings together all the elements one needs to understand the dynamics of agencements. There is an action carried out by the cobbler: he sings at the top of his voice. There is an overflowing that constitutes a problem for his neighbor, bothering and worrying him until his life is so upset that he can no longer sleep. This unbearable overflowing pushes him to act. Action, like life, never begins — it continues. The financier, a connoisseur of the human soul (how could he not be, when he has made a fortune?), does not believe in the stories told according to which human beings are moved only by self-interest, and it is always possible to obtain what one wants for money by upping the stakes. (How much do you want to be quiet?) He knows that the action is directed toward solving problems, and as a good investigator, he interrogates the cobbler in order to discover his main source of concern and worry. He realizes that he will indeed have to pay — not for him to stop singing, but to calm the hunger that drives him. By giving the cobbler money, he ruins his life and cuts him off. Exchanging problems and matters of concern, translating them from one to another and sometimes going so far as to pay in order to create, maintain, and orient this movement — this is the basic module, the simple sequence of distributed collective action. The framed action overflows, it creates trouble that reframes it and reorients it in new directions. The cobbler used to sing and sleep; thanks to the financier, who frees him from hunger, he no longer sings or sleeps, and the story starts again.

这则富有教益的寓言汇集了理解装配动态所需的一切要素。有一个由鞋匠实施的行为：他放声歌唱。有一种溢出，它构成邻居的问题，打扰他、困扰他，直到他的生活被搅得再也无法入睡。这种无法忍受的溢出推动他采取行动。行动如同生命，从不开始——它只是延续。金融家深谙人心（他既然发了财，怎么可能不懂呢？），他不相信那些说法——即人只受自身利益驱动，而且只要不断加码，总能用钱得到自己想要的东西。（你要多少钱才肯安静？）他知道，行动指向解决问题；于是，他像个好探员一样盘问鞋匠，以发现后者主要的关切与忧虑之源。他意识到，自己确实必须付钱——不是为了让他停止歌唱，而是为了平息驱使他的饥饿。把钱给鞋匠，他就毁了鞋匠的生活，也让鞋匠不再歌唱。交换问题与关切事项，把它们从一方转译到另一方，有时甚至不惜付钱，以创造、维持并引导这一运动——这就是基本模块，是分布式集体行动的简单序列。被框定的行动溢出了，它制造麻烦，而麻烦又重新框定它，把它引向新的方向。鞋匠从前又唱又睡；多亏金融家把他从饥饿中解放出来，他不再歌唱，也不再安睡，而故事又重新开始。

All framings overflow. The financier’s motives are not important. The only thing that counts are the concerns he faces and for which he needs a solution. Market agencements go through the same process. Like all agencements, they produce problems, worries, matters of concern. This mode of functioning is neither pathological nor abnormal. It is inherent in agencements, and it is a result of the form collective action takes. In the case of market agencements, in order to produce bilateral transactions and the singularization of goods that doing so requires, this collective action is structured by the five framings. In order to move ahead, it must maintain these framings at all cost, the only solution often being to reconfigure them in order to somehow absorb the overflowings and contestations they provoke. The way a market agencement functions cannot be separated from the dynamic of the matters of concern it raises and from which they overflow or of the ensuing attempts at reframing. Each agencement thus follows a singular trajectory. Each story can, however, be analyzed with the same tools: they derive from the same conceptual framework and make it possible to track the play of forces that organizes around the framings and the problems they raise.

一切框定都会溢出。金融家的动机并不重要。唯一重要的，是他所面对、并需要为之找到解决办法的那些关切。市场装配经历着同样的过程。像所有装配一样，它们生产问题、忧虑与关切事项。这种运作方式既不病态，也不反常。它内在于装配之中，是集体行动所采取之形式的结果。就市场装配而言，为了生产双边交易以及为此所需的物品独一化，这种集体行动由五重框定所结构化。为了继续推进，它必须不惜一切代价维持这些框定；而唯一的办法，往往就是重新配置这些框定，以便以某种方式吸收它们所引发的溢出与争议。市场装配的运作方式，无法与它所引发的关切事项及其溢出动态分离，也无法与随之而来的重新框定尝试分离。因此，每一个装配都遵循一条独一的轨迹。然而，每个故事都可以用同样的工具来分析：这些工具源自同一个概念框架，并使人能够追踪围绕诸框定及其所提出问题而组织起来的力量游戏。
FRAMINGS AND OVERFLOWINGS: A MULTISITED REALITY

Each framing is the source of possible overflowings of matters of concern, which affect and divert the action in unexpected directions. If one wants to describe the way a market agencement functions, the method is therefore obvious: one first has to run through the framings in a careful empirical exploration of the overflowings and the problems they raise and then observe the actions that respond in order to eliminate or reframe the problems. Even though regularities do often appear, due to similarities in framing
dispositifs

, it would make no sense to attempt to establish an exhaustive inventory of these confrontations since circumstances play a determining role in their emergence. The following illustrations supplement what has already been said in the preceding chapters. They are presented only in order to give an overall view of this approach and the way in which it makes it possible to unify a framework of analysis.
框定与溢出：一种多地点现实
每一种框定都是关切事项可能溢出的来源，这些溢出以意想不到的方向影响并偏转行动。因此，若要描述市场装配的运作方式，方法显而易见：首先必须逐一梳理诸框定，对溢出及其所引发的问题进行细致的经验探索，然后观察那些为消除或重新框定问题而作出的回应行动。尽管由于框定
装置
的相似性，规律性确实经常出现，但试图为这些对抗建立一份详尽无遗的清单并无意义，因为情境在其出现过程中起着决定性的作用。以下的例示补充前几章已经说过的话。它们之所以被呈现，只是为了给出这一进路的总体图景，以及它如何使人能够统一一个分析框架。

The overflowings that have been studied the most are those linked to the first market framing, the one concerning goods and their passiva(c)tion. No doubt this is because these issues become more and more visible as commercial activities, which include the domestication of ever more beings, prove to be problematic. The inventory of matters of concern provoked by passiva(c)tion grows longer every day, as does the list of protest movements to draw attention to these matters: chemical substances attacking the environment, threatening health; buried carbon, ceaselessly extracted and spewed into the atmosphere as carbon dioxide, provoking global warming; transgenic organisms that may alter both plant and animal equilibria in the long term; human labor, subjected to machines or ordered to be creative, but not excessively so; animals that are subjugated or transformed into meat; financial derivatives that induce systemic crises; agricultural land sold to property developers. The latter, property rights, call for reshaping existing framings in order to respond to the problems that arise. In the coming years, they will no doubt be at the heart of many claims: it is a question raised by the massive irruption of problems generated by the passiva(c)tion of living beings, but also by the growing importance of free zones, which crystalize novel demands and call for collective property rights to be set up. This might be similar to GNU, the free software system launched by Richard Stallman in 1983, copyleft, or Creative Commons.

研究得最多的溢出，是与第一重市场框定——即关于物品及其被动化的框定——相联系的溢出。这无疑是因为，随着商业活动（其中包括对越来越多存在者的驯化）日益显得问题重重，这些问题也变得越来越可见。被动化所引发的关切事项清单每天都在变长，为引起人们对这些事项注意而发起的抗议运动名单也在变长：攻击环境、威胁健康的化学物质；被埋藏于地下的碳，不断被开采出来，并以二氧化碳的形式喷入大气，引发全球变暖；可能长期改变植物与动物平衡的转基因生物；人类劳动，或被置于机器之下，或被要求具有创造性，但不可过度；被征服或转化为肉类的动物；引发系统性危机的金融衍生品；被出售给房地产开发商的农业用地。后者，即财产权问题，要求重塑既有框定，以回应出现的问题。在未来几年，它们无疑将处于许多诉求的核心：这一问题由生物存在者被动化所引发的种种问题的大规模爆发所提出，也由无交易区日益增长的重要性所提出——无交易区结晶出新的要求，并要求建立集体财产权。这可能类似于理查德·斯托曼（Richard Stallman）于1983年发起的自由软件系统 GNU、copyleft，或知识共享（Creative Commons）。

These big questions, which make the headlines in the media and international conferences, should not make us forget the many overflowings generated by the way the qualification of useful everyday goods is evolving. Despite being less visible, this change can be analyzed in the same terms. For instance, Frank Azimont and Luis Araujo show how food, whose primary function might be to feed, is gradually requalified into foodstuffs with new functions: the foodstuffs not only feed, they can claim to be good for one’s health — what they call “functional goods.”

This transformation and reframing, which modify the programs of action of which the good is capable, are the result of taking into account the untimely overflowings of foodstuffs that, granted, are nourishing, but that stand accused of having negative impacts on consumers’ health. Consumer groups raise a health question whose solution has been inscribed in the good. This opens the way for an extension of existing commercial transactions to constitute a market juxtaposed to the preceding one that it will perhaps one day replace. The turmoil is appeased, the consumer can sleep soundly again, although always in a way that can be disrupted. Are the experts correct who assert that the food is good for one’s health? Are they paid by big agribusinesses that finance their work? Passiva(c)tion is never irrevocable. It is never guaranteed. Indeed, as we saw in Chapter 2, very often, the ways it is obtained can be attacked indirectly, leading to property rights being challenged, as is the case with genetically modified broccoli or when people question the ownership of so-called “individual” data.

这些重大问题占据媒体头条和国际会议，但它们不应让我们忘记：日常有用物品的品质界定方式之演变，也产生了许多溢出。尽管不那么显眼，这一变化仍可以用同样的术语来分析。例如，弗兰克·阿齐蒙（Frank Azimont）与路易斯·阿劳若（Luis Araujo）表明，食物——其主要功能也许是充饥——如何逐渐被重新界定为具有新功能的食品：这些食品不仅能让人吃饱，还可以声称有益于健康——他们称之为“功能物品”（functional goods）。

这一转化与重新框定改变了该物品所能展开的行动程序；它们是人们把食品不合时宜的溢出纳入考虑的结果——这些食品固然富有营养，却被指责对消费者健康有负面影响。消费者群体提出了一个健康问题，而该问题的解决办法已被铭刻在物品之中。这就为既有商业交易的扩展开辟了道路，从而构成一个与前一个市场并置、或许有朝一日将取代它的市场。动荡平息了，消费者又能安然入睡，尽管这种安睡始终可能被打断。那些断言该食品有益健康的专家说得对吗？他们是否受雇于资助其研究的大型农业企业？被动化从来不是不可逆转的。它从来得不到保证。的确，正如我们在第二章所见，被动化的实现方式常常可能遭到间接攻击，从而导致财产权受到质疑，转基因西兰花的情形便是如此，人们质疑所谓“个人”数据的所有权时也是如此。

Formatting qualculating agencies (Chapter 3) is also the source of serious concern. The concern can be about the very modalities of qualculation and the choice of tools and instruments used. Indeed, in light of such concerns, there have been proposals to impose modifications: counting and accounting for the firm’s actions in a different way, no longer allowing shareholder value to be the dominant criterion of action, or encouraging new accounting tools — for instance, by modifying the legal status of corporations.

Simpler suggestions ask that it be made possible for patient groups, nonprofit organizations, or consumer groups to take part in commercial activities from which they are often excluded and to institute new modes of qualculation. These exercises are becoming increasingly complicated because they increase the number of qualculating agencies. The diversity of evaluation tools this diversity produces can lead to frontal oppositions and situations of open conflict.
对质算能动者的格式化（第三章）同样构成严重关切的来源。关切可能针对质算的具体模态，以及所用工具与仪器的选择。的确，面对这类关切，人们提出了施加修改的建议：以另一种方式清点并核算公司的行动，不再让股东价值成为行动的主导标准，或鼓励新的会计工具——例如，通过修改公司的法律地位来做到这一点。
更简单一些的建议则要求：使患者团体、非营利组织或消费者团体有可能参与它们常常被排除在外的商业活动，并创立新的质算模式。这些实践正变得越来越复杂，因为它们增加了质算能动者的数量。这种多样性所产生的评价工具的多样性，可能导致正面冲突和公开对抗的局面。

To continue this overview, we should look at how the organization of encounters (Chapter 4), through the drastic framings it imposes, provoke reactions that focus on contesting the choices made and on challenging the massive exclusions they sometimes produce, leaving vulnerable populations on the sidelines. An increasing number of algorithms, rankings, and classifications are judged to be partial and simplistic. They also have an increasingly strong grip on the establishment of reputations, conformism, or hierarchies, as well as on the competition among agents and on the profiling of our future behavior through the instauration of digital infrastructures that are programmable.

As a result, both the use of algorithms and the modes of qualculation they impose are being challenged. The next step would be to show how attachment devices (Chapter 5) engender critique. Advertising is deemed deceptive or alienating or is mocked. Branding policies and their ambitions to shape consumers’ cultural universes are accused of mystifying and manipulating, promoting the reign of image and appearance. Devices that have users participate in the definition of goods are denounced as strategies for excluding or anesthetizing critical faculties. Recourse to addictive practices can be incriminated for being cynical and immoral.

Finally, to complete an overview, one should review how price formulations (Chapter 6) and the injustices or abuses they nourish are contested, whether it be the pricing of labor, of energy, of food, or of transportation. This work should be extended by looking at the mechanisms of reframing that in some cases make it possible to absorb the challenge and find solutions. It is clear, however, that these analyses cannot be done at an abstract, general level. They make sense only in relation to a particular agencement or a particular area since they must take account of the specificity of both the framings and the matters of concern.
为继续这一概述，我们应当考察相遇的组织（第四章）如何通过它所施加的剧烈框定，激起各种反应——这些反应集中于质疑所作的选择，并挑战它有时产生的大规模排斥，后者把脆弱人群抛在一旁。越来越多的算法、排名与分类被判为片面而简单化。它们对声誉、从众或等级的确立，对行动者之间的竞争，以及通过建立可编程的数字基础设施来为我们未来的行为制作画像，也具有越来越强的掌控力。
结果，算法的使用以及算法所强加的质算模式都受到挑战。下一步应当表明，附着装置（第五章）如何引发批评。广告被认为具有欺骗性或异化作用，或遭到嘲讽。品牌策略及其塑造消费者文化世界的野心，被指控为蒙蔽与操纵消费者，助长图像与表象的统治。让用户参与物品定义的装置，被谴责为排斥或麻醉批判能力的策略。诉诸致瘾做法可能被指为犬儒且不道德。
最后，为完成概述，还应考察价格构式（第六章）以及它们所滋养的不义或滥用如何受到争议，无论涉及的是劳动、能源、食品还是交通的定价。这项工作应当进一步延伸，考察那些在某些情况下使挑战得以被吸收、解决办法得以被找到的重新框定机制。然而，显而易见的是，这些分析不能在抽象、一般的层面上进行。它们只有相对于某个特定装配或特定领域才有意义，因为它们必须顾及诸框定与关切事项二者的特殊性。
Emphasizing the dynamics of framings-overflowings highlights how many diverse trajectories a given agencement can follow. It makes no sense to talk of
an

alternative. There are potentially an infinite number of alternatives. Which ones are actualized depends on the modalities of the different framings, the manner in which the overflowings they provoke are experienced, the way the demands for reframings are expressed, and the nature of the power relations established over the course of these clashes. As Franck Cochoy has rightly noted, it should furthermore be underlined that market agencements not only raise the question of the matters of concern they generate — they also raise the question of how to articulate these matters and of their hierarchy.
强调框定—溢出的动态，凸显了一个既定装配能够遵循多少条各不相同的轨迹。把“替代方案”说成只有
一个
，毫无意义。潜在的替代方案有无限多个。哪些被实现，取决于不同框定的模态、取决于人们如何体验这些框定所引发的溢出、取决于重新框定的要求以何种方式被表达，也取决于在这些冲突过程中所建立起来的权力关系的性质。正如弗兰克·科舒瓦（Franck Cochoy）所正确指出的，还应强调：市场装配不仅提出它们所生成的关切事项的问题，还提出如何接合这些事项以及如何安排其等级的问题。

In general, the different forces around framings and their reconfiguration are not independent of one another. First, some framing devices are found in many market agencements: for example, accounting instruments, property rights, tools for qualculating externalities, meeting algorithms, and so on. Alliances and convergences can therefore be observed with the composition, coordination, and aggregation of local initiatives from site to site, framing to framing. This sometimes leads to the emergence of widely shared movements or the expression of preoccupations and solutions that have a certain generalized status. However, there are also many divergences, and the convergences are often ephemeral and called into question by circumstances. For instance, in their book devoted to contested markets, Philippe Steiner and Marie Trespeuch observe that the response to one matter of concern often creates others that are just as serious, the new configuration producing new fragilities as it seeks to alleviate others.

总体而言，围绕诸框定及其重新配置的不同力量并非彼此独立。首先，某些框定装置出现在许多市场装配之中：例如会计工具、财产权、对外部性进行质算的工具、撮合算法，等等。因此，人们可以观察到联盟与趋同，它们伴随着地方倡议从一个地点到另一个地点、从一重框定到另一重框定的组合、协调与聚合。这有时导致广泛共享的运动出现，或导致具有某种普遍化地位的各种忧虑与解决办法得到表达。然而，分歧也很多，趋同往往是短暂的，并会被情境所质疑。例如，菲利普·施泰纳（Philippe Steiner）与玛丽·特雷斯珀什（Marie Trespeuch）在他们那部专论争议市场的著作中观察到：对某一关切事项的回应，常常创造出同样严重的其他关切事项；新的配置在试图缓解某些脆弱性的同时，又生产出新的脆弱性。

This should not induce extreme relativism. All configurations do not have equal merit. Evaluating them requires discussions and confrontation. I will give a few examples in the following chapter, and I will take a more systematic look at the question of how market agencements and moral and political agencements are articulated in a later book.
