First, I would like to turn to two stylized examples in order to show how attention to framings-overflowings makes it possible to highlight different ways of functioning and therefore contrasting dynamics.
这不应导致极端相对主义。并非所有配置都具有同等价值。评价它们需要讨论与交锋。我将在下一章给出几个例子，并将在之后的一部书中更系统地考察市场装配与道德、政治装配如何接合的问题。首先，我想转向两个经过程式化处理的例子，以表明对框定—溢出的关注如何使人能够凸显不同的运作方式，因而也凸显彼此对照的动态。

In the first case, funerals, there are multiple and heterogeneous forces at work, and the sources of concern that are taken into account are very diverse. Over the long term, a few centuries, the configuration of the market agencements involved in funerals has been profoundly transformed under the pressure of framing and reframing operations. In the second case, housing construction, the power relations have been remarkably stable, at least for the past decades, despite constant attempts at destabilization. The status quo is preserved by maintaining and reinforcing qualculating equipment that allows the agencies in place to impose a certain way of defining and imputing costs. In both cases, the agencements’ dynamics are shaped by how the balance of power evolves around the framings and overflowings.

在第一个案例，即葬礼中，有多种异质力量在起作用，被纳入考虑的关切来源也非常多样。在数百年这一长时段里，葬礼所涉及的市场装配的配置，在框定与重新框定操作的压力下发生了深刻转化。在第二个案例，即住房建造中，权力关系至少在过去数十年里显著稳定，尽管不断有人试图动摇它。现状之所以得以维持，是因为质算装备得到维持与强化，使在位能动者能够强加某种界定并归算成本的方式。在两个案例中，装配的动态都由力量平衡如何围绕诸框定与溢出而演变所塑造。
TRAJECTORY 1: FUNERALS
As Pascale Trompette has shown, the economization of funerals is an old story.

Under the ancien régime, the church played a central role in orchestrating this process by establishing detailed fees depending on the services. A priest sitting with a body through the night was paid three pounds, and the payment by the faithful was understood to be an offering. The church then redistributed the profits to take care of the funerals of the poor. The French Revolution challenged the church’s role. Rather than being considered a purveyor of solutions, its involvement came to be seen as a problem. As undertakers came on the scene, guaranteed a monopoly by local authorities, commercial transactions gradually replaced offerings. This commercial activity was nevertheless framed in such a way as to ensure, through the constitution of a genuine free zone, that services were free for the poor: the contract with municipalities stipulated that companies had to bear the funeral costs of the needy.
轨迹一：葬礼
正如帕斯卡尔·特龙佩特（Pascale Trompette）所表明的，葬礼的经济化由来已久。

在旧制度（ancien régime）下，教会通过按服务项目制定详细费用，在编排这一过程中扮演核心角色。一位整夜守灵的司铎获得三镑报酬，而信众的支付则被理解为一种奉献。教会随后再分配收益，以照料穷人的葬礼。法国大革命挑战了教会的角色。教会的参与不再被视为解决办法的提供者，反而被视为一个问题。随着殡葬承办人登场——地方当局保证其享有垄断——商业交易逐渐取代了奉献。然而，这项商业活动是以这样一种方式被框定的：通过构成一个真正的无交易区，确保穷人能够免费获得服务——与市镇签订的合同规定，公司必须承担贫困者的葬礼费用。

This double framing — noncommercial for the poorest deceased, commercial for the others — creates a specific problem, namely, the problem of how free services should be financed. To handle this, undertakers began increasing the singularization of services. Different classes of funerals were introduced. Personalization and coprofiling entered into the catalogs. Each class has a corresponding basket of services-goods, brought together in a graduated and ordered table where precise descriptions are given of types of coffins, draperies, chandeliers, hearses, and so on. These tables further distinguish the services provided inside the church and those outside. These tools open the way for a formulation that indexes prices on the class of funeral and generate a surplus to finance the poor. The agencement organizes the redistribution of profits — the requirement of free zones that, in this case, articulate commercial activities with social solidarity — to respond to the requirement that the impecunious be looked after. Some do not hesitate to call this economy moral because it endorses the distinction between what is considered superfluous and what is held to be essential, between the ostentatious and the necessary. It is an economy that lacks neither realism nor cynicism: the vanity of some relieves the poverty of others. The border between the two circumscribes a space within which competition can take place for the singularization-differentiation of services.

这种双重框定——对最贫穷的逝者是非商业的，对其他逝者则是商业的——制造了一个特定问题，即免费服务应当如何筹资的问题。为处理这一问题，殡葬承办人开始提高服务的独一化程度。不同等级的葬礼被引入。个性化与共同塑形进入了目录。每一等级都对应一揽子服务—物品，它们被汇集在一张分级而有序的表格中，表格对棺木、帷幔、吊灯、灵车等的类型作出精确描述。这些表格进一步区分教堂内提供的服务与教堂外提供的服务。这些工具为一种价格构式开辟了道路：它使价格与葬礼等级挂钩，并产生盈余以资助穷人。装配组织利润的再分配——这是无交易区的要求，在此情形中，无交易区把商业活动与社会团结接合起来——以回应照顾贫困者的要求。有些人不惮于把这种经济称为道德经济，因为它认可如下区分：被视为多余者与被视为必需者之间的区分，炫耀者与必要者之间的区分。这是一种既不乏现实主义也不乏犬儒主义的经济：一些人的虚荣缓解了另一些人的贫困。二者之间的边界划出一个空间，服务的独一化—差异化竞争便可以在其中展开。

This profitable competitive activity progressively incites new agencies (some of which are actually called “funeral agencies” in French, “agences de funérailles”) to enter the business, concentrating on the organization of ceremonies and on the sale of what is perceived as superfluous, thus endangering the redistributive morality. Beyond this ongoing concern, a further challenge gradually presents companies with an unexpected problem. Death occurs more and more frequently in hospitals or institutions that care for the elderly, rendering the families’ involvement less direct and less pressing. New agencies (hospitals and so on) enter the scene while others, such as the church, slip into the background. The framings that used to create the relations between supplies and demands and affect family members of the deceased so as to lead them to engage in the bilateral commercial transaction become less relevant and effi -cient. The competition to capture bodies (and their families) has gone through a series of reconfigurations, mainly related to the devices that organize matches and the associated attachment devices. The reconfiguration operates in several registers. Legal: there are contracts with municipalities and conventions with hospitals. Spatial: funeral parlors are mostly located inside or near hospitals and become sort of secondary extensions of the hopspital, housing the dead and gathering the families. Often, in fact, the scene of staff in white coats moving between the hospital and the funerary room establishes compelling continuity between the two, even when the staff belongs to the funeral home. The funerary room lays the ground for singularizing services organized around the coffin, its presentation, and the entire setup that goes with it. The coprofiling happens through the choices of the coffin, the flowers, the tomb, the ceremony. It allows for demands to be articulated and an ever-greater individualization of the service to be set up. The market agencement is at its most commercial when it renders competition invisible, sliding the body in one continuous motion from the bed in which death caught it to the room and the coffin where it starts its second career with the undertaker who will distinguish it from the others. Yet there is in fact competition here. The offer, the good, and the supply are so tightly bound and entwined that the other forces are rendered almost invisible, at least for a while.

这种有利可图的竞争活动逐渐吸引新的能动者（其中一些在法语中确实被称为“agences de funérailles”，即“葬礼代理机构”）进入这一行业，它们集中于仪式组织，并销售被视为多余的东西，从而危及再分配的道德。除了这一持续存在的关切，还有另一项挑战逐渐给公司带来一个意想不到的问题。死亡越来越多地发生在医院或照料老年人的机构中，使家属的参与变得不那么直接，也不那么迫切。新的能动者（医院等）登场，而另一些能动者（例如教会）则退入背景。那些曾经用来建立供给与需求之间的关系、并打动逝者家属以引导他们进入双边商业交易的框定，变得不那么相关、也不那么有效。争夺遗体（及其家属）的竞争经历了一系列重新配置，这些配置主要与组织撮合的装置以及相关的附着装置有关。重新配置在几个层面上展开。法律层面：与市镇签订合同，与医院签订协议。空间层面：殡仪馆大多位于医院内部或附近，成为医院的某种次级延伸，安置死者并聚集家属。事实上，身穿白袍的工作人员在医院与停灵室之间往来的场景，常常在二者之间建立起一种令人信服的连续性，即便这些人员属于殡葬公司。停灵室为围绕棺木、棺木的呈现以及与之配套的整套布置而组织的独一化服务奠定基础。共同塑形通过棺木、鲜花、墓穴与仪式的选择而发生。它使各种要求得以被接合，并使服务的个体化程度得以不断提高。当市场装配使竞争变得不可见，把遗体以连续不断的运动从死亡捕获它的那张床滑向停灵室与棺木——在那里，遗体与殡葬承办人开始它的第二段生涯，而承办人将把它与其他遗体区分开来——此时市场装配便处于其最具商业性的状态。然而，这里事实上存在着竞争。要约、物品与供给如此紧密地绑定、交织在一起，以至于其他力量几乎变得不可见，至少在一段时间内如此。

In order to make their services profitable, companies must regularly process a great number of bodies and coffins: this is what makes this device possible. The device holds the entire market agencement together by narrowly aligning the framings and rigidly circumscribing its articulation with the hospital world. Its function is similar to the one that manages and commercializes airplane seats, except that singularized seats are replaced by coffins, by the varieties of wood from which they are made, and by the varying profusion of flowers and processions. The discriminating monopoly collects the consumer surplus, which of course increases profits, but also allows for financing the burials of the poor.
为使服务有利可图，公司必须持续处理大量遗体与棺木：正是这一点使该装置成为可能。该装置通过紧密地对齐诸框定、并严格限定其与医院世界的接合，把整个市场装配维系在一起。其功能类似于管理和商业化飞机座位的装置，只不过被独一化的座位换成了棺木、制棺所用的各种木材，以及数量不一的鲜花与送葬队伍。歧视性垄断收集消费者剩余，这当然增加利润，但也使资助穷人葬仪成为可能。

As I have said, no framing is definitive because each invariably provokes new matters of concern. Recently, small companies that had not enough financial resources to enter the market started denouncing undertakers’ de facto monopoly, rightly explaining that funeral parlors operate as devices to exclude not the bodies, but those service providers who wish to take charge of them in exchange for money. The dynamic resumes. New problems call for new solutions, which have yet to be invented.
正如我所说，没有任何框定是一劳永逸的，因为每一种框定都不可避免地引发新的关切事项。最近，一些没有足够财力进入市场的小公司开始谴责殡葬承办人的事实垄断；它们正确地指出，殡仪馆作为装置，所排斥的并不是遗体，而是那些希望以金钱为交换来接管遗体的服务提供者。动态重新启动。新的问题呼唤新的解决办法，而这些办法尚待发明。

Pascale Trompette retraces the evolution of the funeral market over the long term, illustrating the wellsprings of dynamics in market agencements, showing how such agencements function. She shows how futile it would be to limit the list of agencies involved to those who provide services and those who benefit from them: public powers, religious authorities, and hospital structures are part of the story and indeed play crucial roles. A further lesson is that this story is articulated by successive framings. The development of devices that ensure qualculation and evaluate the services on offer are at the heart of the story. However, the successive devices for the passiva(c)tion of the service are even more central. Where there was once a short circuit that began with the deceased being detached from their family contexts and immediately (re)attached to the church and the communion of saints,

there is now a much longer circuit that after a series of successive attachments transforms an elderly person living in an assisted living facility into a patient hooked up to tubes that are finally unplugged, then into a body lying in a funeral parlor where the family comes (or does not come) to say goodbye before it is shut into a coffin that will be burned in a crematorium; the collection of the ashes are the final moment of this odyssey. How could one hope to penetrate and understand the dynamics of these markets without focusing the analysis on retracing the history of these framings and without drawing the connections between these transformations and the concerns they have produced at different moments in their development, as well as the successive responses to these concerns? The competition that drives market agencements is won or lost on the mastery of these framings and their transformations. As one can see, it concerns the ever more active singularization of services. Each company seeks to respond to the problems raised by reconfiguring the devices more convincingly than the competitors and by offering new services with an even higher degree of individualization. The invention of funeral parlors and the alignment they produce between service passiva(c)tion, qualculation, matching, attachment, and price-formulation devices is not extraneous to the analysis of agencements and their free zones. On the contrary, it is their very substance.

帕斯卡尔·特龙佩特追溯了葬礼市场在长时段中的演变，例示了市场装配中动态的源泉，并表明这类装配如何运作。她表明，若把所涉及的能动者名单局限于服务提供者与受益者，将是多么徒劳：公共权力、宗教权威与医院机构都是这个故事的一部分，而且确实扮演着关键角色。进一步的教益是，这个故事由前后相继的诸框定所接合。确保质算并评价所提供服务的装置之发展，处于故事的核心。然而，用于服务被动化的前后相继的装置甚至更为核心。从前存在一条短回路：死者被从其家庭情境中脱离出来，随即被（重新）附着于教会与诸圣相通（communion of saints）之上；

如今则存在一条长得多的回路：经过一系列前后相继的附着，一位住在辅助生活机构中的老人被转化为一位插着管子的病人，管子最终被拔掉，随后又转化为一具躺在殡仪馆中的遗体，家属来到这里（或没有来）道别，然后遗体被关进棺木，在火葬场焚化；收集骨灰是这段奥德赛的最后时刻。若不把分析集中于追溯这些框定的历史，若不把这些转化与它们在发展不同时刻所产生的关切、以及对这些关切的前后相继的回应联系起来，人们怎能希望深入理解这些市场的动态？驱动市场装配的竞争，其胜负取决于对这些框定及其转化的掌握。可以看到，它涉及日益活跃的服务独一化。每家公司都力求比竞争者更有说服力地通过重新配置装置来回应所提出的问题，并提供个体化程度更高的新服务。殡仪馆的发明，以及它在服务被动化、质算、撮合、附着与价格构式诸装置之间所产生的对齐，并非与装配及其无交易区的分析无关。相反，它正是装配与无交易区的实质本身。
TRAJECTORY 2: HOUSING

The trajectory of the French funeral market is characterized by a profound transformation of framing devices, as well as by a great proliferation of agencies and a spectacular evolution of services. This development is all the more remarkable because the way a society cares for its dead does not lend itself to rapid change. Yet in less than a century, the careers of the deceased have been deeply shaken up and have adapted to the growing reach of commercial transactions: in a sector in which one might have expected only slow and laborious changes, market agencements’ capacity for innovation has turned out to be particularly efficient. Such a capacity for renewal, opening, and adaptation is not the general rule. Other trajectories and other dynamics can be observed. The housing market — not the one for the final resting place of the dead, but the one for homes for the living — is a good example of a sector that has resisted new technologies and new products for decades, despite their being available and promising.
轨迹二：住房

法国葬礼市场的轨迹，以框定装置的深刻转化为特征，同时也以能动者的大量增殖和服务的惊人演变为特征。这一发展之所以格外引人注目，是因为一个社会照料其死者的方式本不适合迅速变化。然而，在不到一个世纪的时间里，逝者的生涯已被深深撼动，并适应了商业交易日益扩大的触及范围：在一个人们或许只期待缓慢而艰难变化的部门中，市场装配的创新能力竟显得格外高效。这种更新、开放与适应的能力并非通则。人们还可以观察到其他轨迹与其他动态。住房市场——不是死者最终安息之所的市场，而是生者居所的市场——就是一个很好的例子：这个部门数十年来一直抵制新技术与新产品，尽管这些技术与产品已经可用且前景可观。

In order to understand how market agencements manage to close in on themselves, to maintain existing alignments and framings, to limit any new articulations that imperil their equilibrium, to rarify the agencies and sites involved, and to contain the expressions of concerns, let us move to England and follow Heather Lovell and Susan Smith in their analysis.

They ask a simple question: Why has the housing market not been transformed by the technique that involves assembling elements prefabricated elsewhere at a building site? The usual answer is that this technology has not spread because the cost of prefabricated elements remains significantly higher (about 10 percent more than the cost of traditional building). However simple and obvious this answer may be, it is also less than satisfying. Whatever the sector, there has been so much invested in existing technologies, so much research done, and so much feedback from experience that they are always superior to technologies that, having never been developed on a large scale, remain expensive! If this were the right explanation, it should then apply to almost all fields of activity, and existing technologies should only very rarely be replaced by emerging technologies.
为了理解市场装配如何设法封闭于自身、维持既有的对齐与框定、限制任何危及自身均衡的新接合、使所涉及的能动者与场所稀少化，并遏制关切的表达，让我们前往英格兰，跟随希瑟·洛弗尔（Heather Lovell）与苏珊·史密斯（Susan Smith）的分析。

他们提出一个简单的问题：为什么住房市场没有被这样一种技术所转化——该技术在建筑工地上组装在别处预制的构件？通常的答案是：这种技术之所以没有推广，是因为预制构件的成本仍然显著更高（比传统建筑的成本高约10%）。无论这个答案多么简单明了，它都不能令人满意。无论在哪个部门，既有技术上都投入了如此之多，进行了如此之多的研究，也积累了如此之多的经验反馈，以至于它们总是优于那些从未大规模开发、因而仍然昂贵的新兴技术！如果这个解释是正确的，那么它应当适用于几乎所有活动领域，而既有技术应当极少被新兴技术取代。

A significant number of studies, however, demonstrate the opposite, and it is easy to account for this supposed anomaly. Emerging technologies can at first take hold in niche markets and then become more competitive as they spread. Taking the long view, entities such as financial markets or public authorities can decide to support new technologies that they view as promising, and so on. These different explanations start from the fact that cost is neither the only nor the most important criterion. The determining element is the existence of groups with enough resources, driven by interests and anticipations that push them to support a new technology rather than the existing one. One might consider this analysis to be sociological, insofar as it emphasizes the power relations between actors with diverging logics. It has the advantage of being able to account for both blocked and open situations: if the balance shifts, the dynamic is likewise reversed.

然而，大量研究证明了相反的情况，而要解释这一所谓的反常也并不困难。新兴技术可以首先在利基市场中立足，然后随着其扩散而变得更具竞争力。从长远看，金融市场或公共当局之类的实体可以决定支持它们认为有前景的新技术，等等。这些不同的解释都从这样一个事实出发：成本既不是唯一的标准，也不是最重要的标准。决定性的要素，是存在一些拥有足够资源的群体，他们受利益与预期的驱动，因而支持一种新技术而非既有技术。人们可以把这种分析视为社会学分析，因为它强调具有不同逻辑的行动者之间的权力关系。它的优势在于能够同时解释受阻与开放的情境：如果力量平衡发生转变，动态也会随之逆转。

Whether precedence is given to the economic explanation or the sociological one or indeed to one that combines them (showing, for instance, how certain actors can manage losses or impose unbearable ones on their competitors), what is generally overlooked in the emergence of new technologies is the role of calculation instruments. In their investigation, Lowell and Smith correct for this blind spot by taking the framings as their point of departure. Asking how costs are calculated, they ascertain that the calculating codes are imposed by traditional building techniques. For example, experts in the field are unanimous in their opinion that in the subsector of prefabricated construction, delivery schedules are kept more closely and there are fewer defects, whereas, in traditional masonry, delays grow and defects multiply. However, these events are not taken into account in the calculations and evaluations that are generally made. This is the case, notably, for the costs that might be associated with defects and delays and that in fact are not integrated into the calculations at all: this exclusion obviously penalizes the prefabricated option. In other words, these failures of the traditional framings are ignored, although they inflict real nuisances on some of the agents — most notably, clients. The calculation instruments render these matters of concern invisible, deny their existence, and ultimately maintain and reinforce the status quo. It is indeed a matter of costs, but it plays out in the choice and design of the instruments that allow for their calculation. It is indeed a matter of power relations, but it plays out in the way in which framing devices (here, calculation codes) treat concerns by ignoring and eliminating them. The situation is secured, with a remarkable economy of means, simply by controlling the qualculation instruments.

无论优先采用经济学解释还是社会学解释，抑或采用把二者结合起来的解释（例如表明某些行动者如何能够承受损失，或把无法承受的损失强加给竞争者），在新技术的涌现中，人们普遍忽视的是计算工具的作用。洛弗尔与史密斯在其研究中以诸框定为出发点，纠正了这一盲点。他们追问成本如何被计算，从而确认：核算规则是由传统建筑技术所强加的。例如，该领域的专家一致认为，在预制建筑这一子部门中，交付进度更受遵守，缺陷也更少；而在传统砌筑中，延误不断增加，缺陷成倍出现。然而，在通常所作的计算与评价中，这些事件并未被纳入考虑。与缺陷和延误相关的成本尤其如此：这些成本事实上根本没有被纳入计算——这种排除显然不利于预制方案。换言之，传统框定的这些失败被忽视，尽管它们给某些行动者——尤其是客户——造成了实实在在的妨害。计算工具使这些关切事项变得不可见，否认其存在，并最终维持和强化现状。这确实是成本问题，但它体现在使成本得以被计算的那些工具的选择与设计之中。这确实是权力关系问题，但它体现在框定装置（在此即核算规则）通过忽视关切、将其排除在核算之外来处理关切的方式之中。仅仅通过控制质算工具，局面便以极为经济的手段得到了确保。

One could easily generalize this analysis. In order to understand why some market agencements follow certain trajectories rather than others, why in some cases configurations develop and transform (in the case of funerals), while, in others, the forces of reproduction are stronger than the forces of transformation (in the case of housing), or again, why the trajectories change over time, moving from blocked to unblocked situations, one should start from the framing dynamics, the overflowings, and the matters of concern they produce, as well as from the reactions and reframings they elicit. This dynamic is saturated with balances of power, which are established and actualized through the design and implementation of framing devices, whether it be the modalities of passiva(c)tion, the choice of qualculation instruments, the organization of matches, the production of attachments, or price formulation.

人们可以轻易地推广这一分析。为了理解为什么某些市场装配遵循某些轨迹而非另一些轨迹，为什么在某些情形中配置得以发展并转化（葬礼的情形），而在另一些情形中再生产的力量强于转化的力量（住房的情形），或者，为什么轨迹会随时间改变、从锁定情境转向解锁情境，人们应当从框定动态、溢出及其所生产的关切事项出发，也从它们所引发的反应与重新框定出发。这一动态充满了力量平衡，而这些力量平衡通过框定装置的设计与实施被建立并实现，无论涉及的是被动化的模态、质算工具的选择、撮合的组织、附着的生产，还是价格构式。

It might seem that there would be no practical consequences to reversing the perspective. In the case of construction, isn’t the main thing to show that it is a matter of both costs and power relations? The answer is no. Consider the types of intervention (for instance, by public authorities) that could encourage the unlocking of the agencement.
人们或许会认为，颠倒视角不会带来任何实际后果。就建筑而言，主要的事情难道不就是表明这既涉及成本，也涉及权力关系吗？答案是否定的。不妨考虑一下，哪些类型的干预（例如公共当局的干预）能够促进该装配的解锁。

By explaining things through arguments about costs, in this case the non-maturity of alternative technologies, one can favor the emergence of the latter by creating protected spaces where first trials can be carried out and where the new technologies can progressively take on the old as they mature. The sociology of interests could push for work on symbolic resources (launching campaigns to show that prefabricated is not synonymous with poor quality) or organizational and financial resources (by facilitating initial investments that are important for the prefabricated sector). In both cases, exploring matters of concern is left aside to make way for political resolve of the most traditional sort.
通过成本论证来解释事情——在此即替代技术尚不成熟——人们可以通过创造受保护的空间来促进后者的涌现：在这些空间中，可以进行最初的试验，而新技术也可以随着成熟逐步与旧技术抗衡。利益社会学则可以推动对象征资源的工作（发起运动，表明预制并不等同于劣质），或对组织与金融资源的工作（为对预制部门至关重要的初期投资提供便利）。在两种情况下，对关切事项的探索都被搁置一旁，让位于最传统意义上的政治决心。

The market agencement perspective provides new targets. It brings out the importance of calculating equipment and pricing formulas and orients possible new interventions toward modifying these devices with the avowed aim of tackling the hidden problems, which exist despite not being explicit. The logic of possible political interventions is to put together powerful alliances in order to impose or generate small changes that may produce considerable effects — for example, penalizing late deliveries or defects. If the aim is to reconcile mass construction with singularization, it should be added in this particular case that the unlocking of the sector would be facilitated if other actions were undertaken at the same time to weigh on other framings (
affectio mercatus
, organization of encounters) in order to assert the superiority of prefabrication over traditional building.
市场装配视角提供了新的目标。它凸显出计算装备与定价公式的重要性，并把可能的新干预导向对这些装置的修改，其公开目标就是处理那些隐而未显、却确实存在的问题。可能的政治干预的逻辑，是组建强大的联盟，以强加或促生可能产生可观效果的小变化——例如，对延迟交付或缺陷施加惩罚。如果目标是使大规模建造与独一化相协调，那么在此特定情形中还应补充：如果同时采取其他行动，对别的框定（市场情动［
affectio mercatus
］、相遇的组织）施加影响，以主张预制优于传统建筑，那么该部门的解锁将会更加容易。

The dynamics of market agencements are organized by the tension between framings and overflowings. They are inscribed in framing devices and in the reconfiguration of these devices. Depending on the forces that intervene and on the balance established among them, the dynamic varies, leading in some cases to lock-ins, and in others to lock-outs. One can imagine weighing in on these dynamics and the effects they produce, on the way that they take matters of concern into account or fail to do so. There is therefore room for engineering, and in particular, for political engineering, which broaches the matter of evaluating different possible configurations. The question is, What is a good market agencement? In the next chapter, I will see how we might begin to answer this question. My aim will not be to get to the bottom of the issue, but rather to stake out some points of reference for work I will develop later.

市场装配的动态由框定与溢出之间的张力所组织。这些动态铭刻在框定装置之中，也铭刻在这些装置的重新配置之中。取决于介入的力量以及它们之间所建立起来的平衡，动态各不相同，在某些情况下导致锁定（lock-in），在另一些情况下则导致锁出（lock-out）。人们可以设想介入这些动态及其所产生的效果，介入它们纳入或不纳入关切事项的方式。因此，这里存在着工程——尤其是政治工程——的空间，而政治工程涉及评价不同可能配置的问题。问题在于：什么是好的市场装配？在下一章中，我将考察我们如何开始回答这个问题。我的目标不是把问题彻底解决，而是为日后的工作标定一些参照点。
